jobs.title: Senior Manager, AI Customer Success
jobs.excerpt: Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust.
jobs.description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success to help us build and lead the Customer Success team for Source by Webflow, a new platform where marketing teams and their AI agents launch, optimize and scale digital experiences together. Source is in limited research preview today, and this team will support customers as it moves into commercial availability.

You’ll start as a player/coach, owning a small portfolio of strategic enterprise Source accounts, including renewals and growth. As Source adoption grows, you’ll build and scale the team. Your job is to help customers get agents into production, prove the business value, and turn that into retention and expansion. This is a first of its kind role for a first of its kind product. There is no playbook yet, and you will write it.

About the role:

  • Location: Remote-first (United States)
  • Full-time
  • Permanent
  • Exempt
  • The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.
    • United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
      • Zone A: $204,000 - $255,000
      • Zone B: $190,000 - $238,000
      • Zone C: $177,500 - $222,000

For sales roles, the ranges provided are the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) ranges, meaning that the ranges include both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’smarket location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:
    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
    • This posting is for a new position
  • Reporting to the Senior Director, Customers Success

As a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success, you’ll …

  • Lead and grow the Source CS team: hire and coach as adoption grows, and build a culture of experimentation and shared learning.
  • Manage strategic Source accounts: serve as an executive sponsor and build relationships with senior marketing, web and engineering leaders.
  • Drive retention and expansion: own renewals, forecasting and account health; partner with Sales on expansion and negotiations; and guide account plans that grow use cases and adoption.
  • Turn Source use cases into results: lead discovery workshops, pilots and agent building, helping customers navigate rollout, adoption and change management.
  • Own customer outcomes: partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solution Architects to move from pilot to production, define success and ROI, and use performance data to drive improvements.
  • Enable customers to scale: establish agent permissions, autonomy and review practices, and develop customer champions and enablement.
  • Build the Source CS operating model: create playbooks, health metrics and AI-powered workflows; partner across teams to shape the roadmap and develop customer references and case studies

About you:

Requirements:

  • 8+ years in customer success, account management or consulting at a B2B software company, including enterprise accounts and executive relationships.
  • 2+ years managing a customer success, account management or customer growth team.
  • Proven success driving retention, expansion and revenue growth against commercial targets such as net revenue retention.
  • Ability to influence executives, both with customers and internally.
  • Technical aptitude across codebases, deployment pipelines, integrations, permissions and security, with the ability to partner credibly with developers. Production coding is not required.
  • Experience in at least one of the following:
    • Applied AI: building real AI workflows or agents, evaluating their output and setting realistic expectations.Digital transformation: leading complex enterprise programs involving integrated systems, workflow automation or platform migrations.
    • Digital transformation: leading complex enterprise programs involving integrated systems, workflow automation or platform migrations.

You’ll thrive as a Senior Manager, AI Customer Success if you:

  • Think in systems, spot bottlenecks and build repeatable processes with measurable results.
  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building a team, product motion or playbook from the ground up.
  • Understand how marketing and digital experience tools, including CMS, martech and analytics, connect to business outcomes.
  • Bring relevant experience with usage or consumption based pricing, agencies or systems integrators, or Webflow and its customers. These are welcome strengths, rather than requirements.
  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors:

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

Remote, together

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Pre-Filing Paralegal Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law.  Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA.
jobs.description:
Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law.

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don’t just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself.

  • Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here.
  • Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here.
  • Learn more about our Core Values here.

Role Objective

We are looking for an organized, empathetic, and detail-oriented Pre-Filing Specialist to join our Onboarding & Evidence Team. In this role, you will be the bridge between our new clients and the legal team, ensuring a seamless transition into our firm. You will manage the initial stages of the client journey—from opening matters and conducting onboarding calls to gathering, translating, and organizing crucial evidence.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels at high-volume caseload management, and possesses the emotional intelligence needed to support clients going through stressful or sensitive situations.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Conduct onboarding calls: Welcome new clients, gather required background information, and explain the onboarding process clearly without providing legal advice.
  • Client care: Maintain consistent communication with clients, providing timely updates regarding next steps and following up on outstanding documents, questionnaires, signatures, photos, and records.
  • Language support: Translate client documents and assist with Spanish/English interpretation during calls when needed.
  • File setup: Open new client matters in Filevine, ensuring client profiles are accurate. Review contracts, HubSpot info, intake notes, and prior communications before starting onboarding.
  • Evidence gathering: Collect, review, organize, rename, and upload client evidence.
  • Government requests: Request, track, and process government evidence (including FOIA and background requests) according to firm training.
  • Documentation: Prepare clear case notes, task updates, and next-step documentation within Filevine.
  • Issue identification: Spot missing information, urgent issues, or complex client questions, and identify when a matter requires attorney or paralegal review.
  • Cross-department coordination: Partner with paralegals, attorneys, reception, sales, finance, and other departments to keep cases moving.
  • Case handoff: Support the smooth transition of cases to the paralegal team once onboarding and evidence collection are complete.
  • This role requires strong client-centered communication. You must be able to speak with clients in a calm, respectful, and empathetic way, especially when they are frustrated, scared, confused, or emotional.

Requirements.

  • High-Volume Management: Strong organization and time management skills; ability to handle multiple priorities and a heavy caseload.
  • Attention to Detail: Deep focus on accuracy when following processes and documenting case work.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with process changes, shifting priorities, and fast-paced environments.
  • Tech-Savvy: Proficiency with case management systems, calendars, email, Teams, and spreadsheets.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: English/Spanish bilingual skills are highly preferred for client communication, interpretation, and document translation.
  • Professional Boundaries: Clear understanding of the difference between administrative/legal support and giving legal advice.
  • Immigration Law: Prior experience in immigration legal support is a plus.
  • Case Types: Familiarity with family-based, humanitarian, consular processes, T Visa, U Visa, VAWA, AOS, or similar case types.
  • Background Requests: Experience requesting or processing FOIAs, FBI background checks, police records, or court records.
  • Software: Experience using Filevine, HubSpot, Monday.com, Outlook, or Teams is highly advantageous.

What We Offer.

  • Full-time, long-term remote contract position.
  • $26,000 to $30,000 net depending on experience.
  • M-F 9am to 6pm Arizona Time.
  • The opportunity to work alongside a high-performing, fast-growing US immigration law firm.
  • A supportive, mission-driven team culture that values professional growth.
Salary: $26,000 to $30,000 MXN DOE

jobs.excerpt: Data Program AssociateAcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20.
jobs.description:
Data Program Associate

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

We are currently seeking a Data Program Manager to join our Product team and push forward our data products. In this role, you will be responsible for execution on acquiring data. This is primarily via AI driven curation work, building agents, evaluating quality, and ongoing systems to maintain them over time. You will also occasionally be responsible for acquiring new datasets with third parties. This will require close collaboration with peers on the product team to prioritize the right datasets, evaluate ROI and data quality, and ensure the business can make investment decisions correctly.

With empathy for how we collect, curate, and use data, you will use AI both at work and in our official data pipelines to help create and acquire datasets.

Team Mission

The AcuityMD platform features data from across the healthcare industry. Our data assets are the foundation of our application and central to the value we deliver to clients. The quality of our data is paramount for building trust with new clients and maintaining trust with existing clients. We operate in a field where we must constantly search for ground-truth data we can leverage to improve the quality of our product.

Responsibilities

  • Build AI agents to acquire new data, define the ways we measure data quality, identify where and how we can improve our data and processes.
  • Partner with the product teams to coordinate deployment of the data into the product for customers.
  • Help define KPIs on how we measure the quality of our datasets, tied to customer outcomes.
  • Execute on new data acquisition with third parties. Including but not limited to coordination, contracting process, and ensuring alignment to the business value.

Your Profile

  • 0-5 years of relevant experience (data analyst, light engineering, or otherwise)
  • You build empathy for customer problems and seek to understand, question, and improve the user experiences
  • A plus if you are familiar with some programming language - python, R, sql, or other scripting language.
  • A plus if you have experience engaging external vendors and going through discovery processes.
  • You’re exceptionally organized and can drive multiple projects forward simultaneously.
  • You’re comfortable with spreadsheets and structuring analyses and summaries out from them.
  • You seek hard problems to solve and are comfortable with ambiguity. You often structure your thinking in writing to sort through ambiguity.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, can reason through tradeoffs, and tell stories using data
  • You have a bias towards action
  • You’re eager to learn new skills around building AI systems and roll up your sleeves to ensure they’re of high quality with evals.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $85,000 - $125,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

jobs.excerpt: About Nerdio At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.
jobs.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Controller to own the integrity, timeliness, and scalability of our accounting operations. Reporting to the VP, Accounting, you will lead the day-to-day close, manage our US and international audits, help us build a scalable pricing, packaging, and billing engine for our multi-channel business, serve as a senior technical accounting resource, and build the processes and team that keep us audit-ready year-round, not just at year-end. This is a role for someone with technical depth, sound business judgment, and a bias for building. We welcome both experienced Controllers and standout Assistant Controllers ready to step into their first Controller role.

What you'll do

Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, driving continuous reduction in close cycle time while maintaining accuracy
  • Review account reconciliations, journal entries, and flux analyses; ensure clean, GAAP-compliant financial statements
  • Prepare and review financial reporting packages for the board, PE sponsor, and lenders, including covenant compliance

Technical Accounting

  • Apply US GAAP to complex SaaS and usage-based transactions, including ASC 606 (revenue recognition), ASC 340-40 (capitalized commissions), ASC 718 (stock-based compensation), ASC 805 (business combinations), and ASC 842 (leases)
  • Account for revenue across our multi-channel business (direct, partner and reseller, and marketplace), including principal vs. agent, gross vs. net, and channel incentive considerations
  • Draft and maintain technical accounting memos and accounting policies
  • Evaluate the accounting impact of new contracts, pricing models, and strategic transactions, including M&A

Audit & Controls

  • Lead the consolidated US audit as primary liaison to our Big 4 auditor; manage PBC lists, timelines, and year-round audit readiness
  • Own audits at key international entities, including the UK and Germany
  • Design, document, and monitor internal controls with a SOX-readiness mindset and drive continuous improvement
  • Coordinate tax compliance with external advisors, including sales/use, income, and international

Global Payroll & Compliance

  • Review and ensure compliance for US payroll and international Employer of Record (EOR) services across all countries where Nerdio employs people

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the accounting team (GL, revenue, AP, payroll, and related functions)
  • Set clear expectations, build succession, and foster a culture of ownership and accountability

Systems & Process

  • Act as a champion for our finance tech stack (NetSuite, Ramp, FloQast), driving automation and efficiency
  • Identify and implement process improvements, including AI and automation tooling, to scale without proportional headcount

Pricing, Packaging & Billing

  • Be a key finance partner in building a nimble pricing, packaging, and billing solution that lets us launch and change offers quickly without breaking the close
  • Translate new pricing models and channel structures into scalable billing, revenue recognition, and reconciliation processes, working closely with Product, RevOps, and Systems teams
  • Ensure billing data flows accurately and consistently from each channel into NetSuite and the financial statements

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A, Revenue Operations, Legal, Sales Ops, and HR on forecasting, deal structures, and compensation accounting
  • Support finance integration for acquisitions and new entities
  • Contribute to the accuracy and understanding of SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn) alongside GAAP results

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • Active CPA license
  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 2-4 years in a Controller role, or a strong Assistant Controller / Accounting Manager ready for a first Controller role
  • Strong command of US GAAP, with demonstrated SaaS revenue recognition experience (ASC 606)
  • Experience managing and developing accounting teams and supporting external audits
  • Exceptional analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Preferred skills

  • Big 4 or national public accounting firm experience
  • Experience in a PE-backed company, including sponsor and lender reporting
  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite, Ramp, and FloQast
  • Multi-entity and international accounting experience, including foreign currency and local statutory audits
  • M&A and purchase accounting experience
  • SOX or SOX-readiness experience

Benefits and Incentives

  • Competitive Base + Annual bonus up to 10%
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off......including your birthday off!

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we’re building together. We’re committed to providing employees with a meaningful work experience and have established an award-winning culture that supports personal and career development in a fun, casual, and collaborative environment.

Who We Want

We want an analytical, self-driven, and detail-oriented Claims Analyst to join our growing Arrive Fresh division. You’ll own a portfolio of temperature-controlled and perishable cargo claims, protecting Arrive’s financial position while serving as a responsive, trusted partner to our customers and carriers. You bring hands-on claims experience and a working knowledge of cargo liability, PACA, and food safety rules, and you’re eager to deepen your cold-chain expertise. You move with urgency when perishable freight is at risk, communicate clearly under pressure, and know when to escalate. Your follow-through and collaborative approach will help Arrive Fresh scale and strengthen our reputation as a premier cold-chain partner.

What You'll Do

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of Arrive Fresh cargo claims from initial filing to final resolution, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely outcomes.
  • Investigate and resolve temperature-controlled freight claims involving reefer temperature deviations, pulp readings, transit delays, shelf-life deterioration, and USDA inspection results, applying PACA guidelines and the Carmack Amendment.
  • Negotiate and settle cargo loss, damage, shortage, and contamination claims with shippers, receivers, carriers, and insurance adjusters within established authority levels.
  • Act quickly to mitigate losses on perishable freight by coordinating salvage, redistribution, or disposal in line with food safety and FSMA requirements.
  • Collect and validate claim documentation, including temperature logs, bills of lading, USDA inspections, and invoices, to build defensible positions for recovery and subrogation.
  • Reconcile claim-related receivables and payables, secure releases, and execute assignments of rights to maintain financial accuracy.
  • Track claims data and trends to flag risk areas, recurring issues, and carrier performance concerns, and share findings with Arrive Fresh leadership.
  • Partner with Carrier Sales, Business Delivery, Legal, and Operational Risk to address high-risk shipments and align on dispute resolution.
  • Escalate complex, high-value, or litigated claims to the Arrive Fresh Risk Manager with a clear summary and recommended path forward.
  • Monitor cold-chain compliance and carrier vetting standards for temperature-controlled freight, enforcing reefer unit certifications, temperature-recording protocols, pre-cooling requirements, and FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule compliance.
  • Oversee operational risk workflows for rejected, stranded, or high-risk perishable loads, coordinating real-time reefer temperature deviation reviews, offsite restacks, and carrier holds or decertifications to prevent financial loss.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date claim records in the TMS and claims management system, and keep customers and carriers informed of claim status.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field (Supply Chain, Business Administration, Finance, or related) or equivalent professional experience preferred.
  • 3+ years of cargo claims management experience, with a heavy emphasis on 3PL, freight brokerage, or cargo insurance environments.
  • Deep knowledge of perishable freight laws and standards, including the Carmack Amendment, PACA (Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act) guidelines, USDA standards, and FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act).
  • Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and critical thinking skills, with a track record of handling high-value settlements and complex legal disputes.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and intensive attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, freight broker TMS platforms, and claims management software.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a focus on proactive, collaborative customer and carrier relationship management.

The Perks of Working With Us

  • Take advantage of our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage.
  • Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program.
  • Build relationships and find your home at Arrive through our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Take time to manage your physical and mental health - we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days.
  • Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent.
  • Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program!

Your Arrive Experience

When we say “award-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. We’re committed to culture because it keeps us connected to each other and invested in our shared success while having a blast along the way. Our employee-founded resource groups create communities within Arrive’s walls, including Women in Logistics, Emerging Professionals, Prisms, Black Logistics Group, Salute and Unidos.

To ensure a safe and transparent interview process, we want to note that Arrive Logistics adheres to strict recruitment practices. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

jobs.description:
The Jed Foundation (JED) is a nonprofit that protects emotional health and prevents suicide among the nation’s teens and young adults. JED’s School Programs and Consulting (SPC) division partners with high schools, districts, colleges, and community-based organizations to assess student needs, build customized strategic plans, and provide sustained technical assistance that leads to measurable improvements in student mental health. The Regional Director, Intermountain West will serve as JED’s representative and relationship-builder across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming; three frontier states where geographic distance, workforce shortages, and fragmented local systems make coordinated, trusted regional infrastructure essential. This is a hybrid strategic and operational leadership role: the Director will build JED’s brand and network across the region, generate and cultivate new partnership and business opportunities, and help lead and support, in a matrixed capacity, the region’s Consultants delivering JED’s District Mental Health Initiative (DMHI) and other school-based programming, and represent the full breadth of JED’s work — schools and districts first, alongside JED’s programming for community-based organizations (CBOs) to education leaders, state agencies, coalitions, funders, and (as JED’s merger with AFSP progresses) AFSP chapters across the three states. The Director generates leads for new school and community partnerships, opens doors, and builds the relationships that make new opportunities possible, then coordinates closely with JED’s School Partnerships team to convert those opportunities into signed engagements. Success in this role depends on deep relationship-building instincts, comfort operating as a public-facing ambassador, and the management skill to lead a small, geographically dispersed regional consulting team. This is a remote, Intermountain West–based position with regular travel across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming (approximately 40–50%) and periodic travel to JED’s NYC headquarters. Candidates should reside in the Mountain West Region

Key Responsibilities

Regional Brand-Building, Relationship Cultivation & Convening (30%)
  • Serve as JED’s primary face and voice across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming, building JED’s name recognition and credibility among education and mental health leaders in a region where JED’s brand is still emerging.
  • Build and steward relationships with key state and regional entities, including state Departments of Education, Departments of Health and Human Services, Tribal education authorities, and regional education associations.
  • Cultivate relationships with community-based organizations (youth-serving, school-adjacent) and local nonprofits, and with philanthropic partners active in the region, including funders such as The Ortus Foundation.
  • Represent JED in influential relationship-building spaces, including community coalitions, advisory boards, task forces, and public forums positioning JED as a convener that brings together local partners, CBOs, and funders around shared youth mental health goals, not only as a service provider.
  • Serve as JED’s regional liaison to AFSP chapters across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming as JED’s merger with AFSP advances, identifying opportunities for AFSP chapters to engage in and support JED’s regional work.
New Business Development & Lead Generation (20%)
  • Identify and cultivate new leads and partnership opportunities with districts, high schools, and CBOs across the region.
  • Coordinate closely and consistently with JED’s School Partnerships team, handing off qualified leads and supporting the relationship context needed to close new district and school engagements.
  • Track and manage the regional pipeline of prospective partners, using Salesforce or other CRM tools to document engagement and coordinate handoffs.
  • Identify opportunities to align JED’s work with existing state initiatives and funding streams to expand reach and long-term sustainability.
Team Leadership & Program Oversight (30%)
  • Matrix-manage JED’s regional Senior Consultants/Consultants delivering the District Mental Health Initiative and other school-based programming across Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming in close partnership with the Senior Director, District Programs.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, and performance management; monitor caseloads and ensure program milestones and quality standards are met across the regional portfolio.
  • Coordinate across the region’s consulting team to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery of JED’s Comprehensive Approach to Mental Health Promotion and Suicide Prevention for Districts.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, and future scaling of regional consulting capacity as JED’s presence in the Intermountain West grows.
Ambassador for JED’s Full Program Portfolio (15%)
  • Serve as spokesperson and ambassador for the full range of JED’s programs and relationships including JED High School, JED and AASA’s District Mental Health Initiative, JED Campus, and JED’s CBO-focused trainings and programming with the deepest focus on JED’s work in schools, and specifically districts and high schools.
  • Attend and present at regional conferences and convenings, sharing JED’s model and advocating for comprehensive, systems-based mental health programming.
  • Serve as a thought leader on emotional health promotion and suicide prevention tailored to the frontier and rural context of the Intermountain West.
Division-Wide Support (5%)
  • Work closely with SPC leadership on regional strategy, team culture, and cross-team initiatives.
  • Contribute regional insight to the design and refinement of JED’s programmatic and consulting materials, particularly as they relate to frontier, rural, and tribal communities.
  • Other duties as assigned by JED leadership related to regional programming and partnerships.
Competencies:
  • Scope and Execution: Operates as a subject matter expert who drives regional strategy and independently identifies stakeholders and resources needed to advance JED’s work.
  • People Leadership & Management: Builds and actively supports matrixed management of a high-performing, geographically dispersed team; coaches, sets expectations, and gives timely feedback.
  • Relationship Building & External Representation: Prioritizes relationship-building as a core function of the role; comfortable convening diverse partners (government, nonprofit, philanthropic) around shared goals.
  • Communication: Communicates JED’s mission and program model clearly to varied audiences, from district superintendents to state agency leaders to funders.
  • Collaboration and Cross-Team Impact: Coordinates seamlessly with School Partnerships, SPC program teams, and JED’s broader leadership to convert relationships into results.
  • JED Citizenship: Represents JED’s mission and Comprehensive Approach with credibility and cultural humility, particularly when engaging Tribal nations and frontier communities.

Skills Knowledge and Expertise

  • Master’s degree in education, educational leadership, counseling, psychology, social work, public health, or related field.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of experience in PK–12 mental health programming, youth-serving nonprofit work, or education leadership, with a focus on suicide prevention preferred.
  • Minimum of 2+ years managing teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
  • Deep knowledge of the Idaho, Montana, and/or Wyoming education and youth mental health landscape, including experience working with frontier, rural, and Tribal communities.
  • Demonstrated track record of building relationships with state agencies, nonprofits, and funders, and identifying new business or partnership opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to senior leaders, state officials, and community groups.
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM/project management tools.
  • Passion for youth mental health and alignment with JED’s Guiding Principles and Shared Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Antiracism.

About the team

At Zillow Home Loans, we’re at the forefront of revolutionizing the home financing experience. As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment. We’re a team of innovators, problem solvers, and creative individuals pushing the boundaries of the mortgage industry.

Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Utah.   • Maintain active licensing, complete required education, and participate in ongoing professional development.

In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance, and location.

U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

  • Proven success originating purchase loans in either: a high-volume, phone-based sales environment or an agent-centric referral model.

  • Comfortable working in a structured, performance-driven environment with clearly defined KPIs.

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and ability to build trust quickly.

  • Strong time management, organization, and pipeline management skills.

  • Proficiency with CRM, LOS, and Microsoft products (Outlook, Word, Excel).

  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. You overthink every care option and scenario because, as a Care Manager, you’re the hub of your patient's case management and care plan. Achieving the best possible patient outcomes, appropriate length of stay, efficient utilization of resources, coordination of patient, family, and staff communication and education is the center of your nursing universe.

You give new meaning to a 9 to 5 schedule because caring doesn’t stop just because you’ve punched a clock and neither does your innovative brain.   • Triage symptom-based calls per approved protocols for a wide range of patients.

  • Document all workflows in EPIC system for purposes of tracking and quality assessment.

  • Educate enrolled members on chronic and acute disease processes.
  • Interact with LCMC Health care partners, leadership and/or physicians to discuss clinical questions, concerns, strategies, and care plans to achieve quality and cost management objectives.
  • Demonstrate energy, excitement, and a passion for quality work.

The Must-Haves

  • Current nursing license to practice in Louisiana and as defined by the Louisiana State Board of Nursing.
  • 2 years of professional nursing or care management experience.

WORK SHIFT:

Days (United States of America)

LCMC Health is a community.

Our people make health happen. jobs.description:
About Us

Sophos is a cybersecurity leader defending 600,000 organizations globally with an AI-driven platform and expert-led services. Sophos meets organizations wherever they are in their security maturity and grows with them to defeat cyberattacks. Its solutions combine machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with frontline human expertise from Sophos X-Ops to deliver advanced, 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response.
Sophos offers industry-leading managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies — including endpoint, network, email, and cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Together with expert advisory services, these capabilities help organizations proactively reduce risk and respond faster, with the visibility and scalability needed to stay ahead of evolving threats.
Sophos goes to market with a global partner ecosystem, including Managed Service Providers (MSPs), Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs), resellers and distributors, marketplace integrations, and cyber risk partners, giving organizations the flexibility to choose trusted relationships when securing their business. Sophos is headquartered in Oxford, U.K. More information is available at .

Role Summary

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Sophos Endpoint Windows Platform strategy, roadmap, and product execution. This role leads the Windows platform foundation that powers Sophos Endpoint protection, detection, response, management, and go-to-market outcomes at global scale. You will define where the Windows platform needs to go, turn complex operating system and security requirements into clear product priorities, and drive execution across Engineering, Sophos X-Ops, Sophos MDR Ops, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and strategic technology partners.

This person must bring deep Windows operating system knowledge and strong endpoint security judgment. Success requires hands-on understanding of Windows internals, endpoint agent architecture, security controls, deployment models, performance, compatibility, telemetry, and platform change management. The role also requires close partnership with Microsoft on critical roadmap initiatives that affect endpoint security, customer trust, and Sophos market leadership.

What You Will Do

    Be the product leader for the Sophos Endpoint Windows Platform by understanding how customers, managed service providers, security teams, and internal Sophos teams rely on Windows endpoints for prevention, detection, response, administration, and operational resilience.

  • Own product strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the Sophos Endpoint Windows Platform.
  • Develop the Windows platform strategy for Sophos Endpoint, including platform modernization, operating system readiness, security control evolution, agent architecture, performance, compatibility, reliability, and customer deployment success.
  • Work closely with Microsoft on critical strategic roadmap initiatives, ecosystem changes, platform dependencies, security integrations, and early engagement opportunities that affect Sophos Endpoint customers.
  • Translate Windows operating system changes, customer needs, threat landscape shifts, partner requirements, and business priorities into a clear product roadmap that engineering teams can execute.
  • Partner with Engineering to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, sequence platform investments, and deliver high-quality Windows endpoint capabilities at scale.
  • Serve as the Windows platform product owner for cross-portfolio teams, including Sophos XDR, EDR, MDR, Workspace Protection, X-Ops, NG-SIEM, and Endpoint Management.
  • Use endpoint telemetry, customer feedback, field input, support trends, competitive analysis, and platform data to prioritize work and make clear product decisions.
  • Support go-to-market enablement by developing launch narratives, field guidance, partner messaging, customer-facing positioning, adoption plans, and roadmap communication for Windows platform initiatives.
  • Represent Sophos Endpoint Windows Platform in customer councils, executive briefings, partner conversations, Microsoft engagements, competitive reviews, analyst discussions, and internal strategy forums.

What You Will Bring

  • 10+ years of product management, platform product management, endpoint security, enterprise security, Windows platform, or adjacent technical product experience.
  • Extensive understanding of the Windows operating system and platform, including endpoint security architecture, kernel and user-mode considerations, security controls, deployment models, diagnostics, performance, compatibility, operating system lifecycle, and platform change management.
  • Demonstrated success defining and shipping platform capabilities that improve security efficacy, endpoint resilience, customer deployment success, operational efficiency, or revenue growth.
  • Proven ability to work with strategic technology partners, ideally including Microsoft, to influence platform direction, prepare for ecosystem changes, and protect customer outcomes.
  • Strong technical fluency across endpoint protection, detection and response, agent architecture, telemetry, update systems, operating system compatibility, and enterprise endpoint administration.
  • Ability to translate deep technical platform work into clear roadmap priorities, executive narratives, customer value, sales enablement, partner guidance, and adoption plans.
  • Strong product judgment, ownership, urgency, curiosity, and humility, with a proven ability to use data, customer insight, technical depth, and stakeholder input to make clear decisions.
  • Clear, concise communication skills across executives, engineering leaders, field teams, partners, customers, and external technology stakeholders.
  • Experience building or enabling go-to-market plans for enterprise security products, including launch readiness, customer messaging, partner enablement, and field training.

Ready to Join Us?

At Sophos, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives to fuel innovation. Research shows that candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don't check every box in a job description. We challenge that notion. Your unique experiences and skills might be exactly what we need to enhance our team. Don't let a checklist hold you back – we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is one of the fastest-growing startups in the healthcare industry, working tirelessly to connect people everywhere to life-saving mental health and substance use treatment.

As a SUD Referral Relations Specialist, you will join a founding go-to-market team responsible for scaling Charlie Health's Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program nationally. SUD represents our next major growth vertical, and this team is charged with building the playbook. Where our Outreach team builds the relationships that point people toward care, you will make sure they get there.

Connecting someone with a substance use concern to treatment takes more than a warm handoff. Clients often come to us in crisis, in unstable circumstances, and at the hardest possible moment to keep an appointment. You will own the daily work of making sure no one is lost in that gap — identifying clients whose care has stalled, reaching out directly to get them rescheduled, coordinating with our Admissions team, and keeping referral partners informed on every client they send us.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our SUD-focused Outreach Team and Admissions team.

This role is best suited for someone who thrives in high-accountability environments and wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up. In your role, you'll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers. You'll also receive competitive benefits, ensuring you have the resources to thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Responsibilities

  • Own the client journey from first contact through the start of care, making sure no one falls out of the process along the way
  • Serve as the connective tissue between referral partners, clients, and our Admissions team
  • Keep referral partners closely informed on the people they entrust to us, building confidence in Charlie Health as a long-term care partner
  • Partner with our Outreach team to keep every client moving toward treatment, and coach on pipeline strategy so their time stays focused in the field
  • Identify barriers to care as they surface and escalate the patterns behind them

Requirements

  • Experience in direct client-facing role (e.g. Admissions Team), particularly in the mental health field, preferred.
  • Support pipeline management activities during key Central Time and West Coast time hours (11am to 7pm ET).
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Familiarity with and willingness to use cloud-based communication software—Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox, Salesforce–in addition to EMR and survey software on a daily basis.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $55,000 and $65,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role also offers a performance bonus. The expected total cash compensation range, including potential bonus, will be between $71,500 and $84,000 per year. Further, cash compensation is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may include stock options and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits.

jobs.description:
Job Title: (Associate) Director, Medical Liaison - North Central USA

Job Location: Remote, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Overview

Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company, is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions.Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as a Great Place to Work® in 2026.

The MSL will serve as a field-based scientific expert responsible for engaging with healthcare professionals (HCPs), supporting clinical development, and ensuring alignment with Centessa’s strategic medical objectives. This role is critical in translating complex scientific data into meaningful clinical insights and fostering compliant, evidence-based dialogue with thought leaders.

Responsibilities

Scientific Expertise & Thought Leader Engagement

  • Maintain a high level of therapeutic area expertise and scientific knowledge relevant to Centessa’s pipeline and marketed products in alignment with Medical Affairs strategic objectives

  • Engage in compliant, non-promotional scientific exchange with key opinion leaders (KOLs), investigators, and other HCPs

  • Serve as a trusted scientific resource to external stakeholders, providing accurate and balanced medical information

  • Deliver company-approved, high-quality medical/scientific presentations to a variety of audiences including formulary committees and healthcare professionals.

  • Provide medical/scientific support for critical Centessa activities including speaker training, advisory boards, and sales training as appropriate

  • Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant documentation of field-based activities in accordance with MSL organization guidelines

Clinical Trials Support

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to identify and evaluate potential clinical trial sites and investigators based on scientific expertise, patient population, and alignment with study objectives

  • Provide scientific education and protocol-specific training to investigators and site staff during site initiation visits, ensuring thorough understanding of study rationale and endpoints

  • Maintain ongoing engagement with trial sites and investigators to facilitate successful execution of clinical trial objectives, provide ongoing scientific support, address protocol-related inquiries, and ensure high-quality data generation

Medical Conference Attendance & Coverage

  • Attend relevant scientific and medical congresses to stay current with emerging data and trends

  • Provide real-time insights and post-conference reports to internal teams

  • Support Centessa’s presence at congresses through development of pre-conference plans, booth coverage, symposia participation, and KOL engagement

Scientific Materials Development

  • Contribute to the development of scientific slide decks, FAQs, and educational materials

  • Writing and editing Medical Information response letters

  • Ensure all materials are medically accurate, evidence-based, and compliant with regulatory standards

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs and Legal teams to ensure scientific content meets internal and external guidelines

Additional responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  • Leading MSL strategic initiatives/projects aligned with Medical Affairs and MSL organization strategy

  • Develop and implement scientific training plans for the MSL team

  • Mentorship of MSL peers

Basic Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD) in life sciences or a related field (from An Accredited College or University).

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a Medical Affairs or MSL role within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry

  • Excellent understanding of sleep medicine and associated therapeutic areas strongly preferred

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; ability to tailor scientific messages to diverse audiences and ability to interpret and communicate complex scientific data

  • Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with KOLs, investigators, and internal stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, regulatory requirements, and therapeutic area landscape

  • Skilled in developing and delivering scientific presentations in various settings

  • Strong understanding of industry regulations and guidelines governing medical interactions

  • Ability to align field activities with broader medical and corporate strategies

  • Must have a valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company requirements

  • Willing and able to travel frequently throughout the North Central territory, including Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, with primary coverage of major metropolitan and academic medical center markets across the region.

  • Must reside in the Chicago metropolitan area or, alternatively, in a major metropolitan area within the North Central territory with convenient access to a major commercial airport to support frequent travel throughout the region.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Events Manager
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Abnormal is growing fast, and the way we show up in the world has to keep pace. Our events are where our story becomes an experience—bringing customers, prospects, partners, and security leaders closer to our brand, our products, and our people.

Our owned events give us the opportunity to set the agenda and create experiences that bring Abnormal’s story to life. Our executive programs create space for the world’s most influential security leaders to engage directly with our leadership, our product, and one another. And at key third-party events, we meet the security community on its own turf—turning moments of engagement into meaningful relationships.

As Senior Strategic Events Manager, you’ll play a leading role in bringing these experiences to life, with a primary focus on Abnormal’s owned, executive, and internal events, while also supporting select high-impact third-party programs.

You’ll own end-to-end delivery across a diverse portfolio—from summits, roadshows, customer programs, and executive experiences to internal events and major industry moments. You’ll translate our broader event strategy into exceptional programs: shaping agendas and experiences, managing budgets and vendors, coordinating cross-functional teams, and leading execution on the ground to ensure every detail lands.

This is a hands-on IC role for someone who thinks like a strategist and executes like an owner. You'll have a portfolio, a budget, a set of very high standards, and the autonomy to go build. As Abnormal’s event portfolio continues to grow, so will the scope of this role—with a clear path toward greater strategic ownership of our owned, executive, and internal event portfolio.

What You'll Own

First-Party & Third-Party Events

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of some of Abnormal's key strategic events — from strategy and budget through delivery, measurement, and post-event analysis.
  • Own every component that makes an owned event work: venue and vendor selection, production, registration and attendee journey, hospitality, staffing, technology, and on-site operations — partnering with Brand Creative, Content, and Comms on creative, branding, and agenda.
  • Build the run-of-show, the project plan, the timeline, and the contingency plan — then run the room.
  • Partner with Sales, Strategic Alliances, Campaigns, Field Marketing, Product Marketing, and others to make sure every event is engineered for pipeline and customer engagement, not just attendance.
  • Manage budgets, contracts, POs, and vendor deliverables with real rigor. Know where every dollar went and what it returned.
  • Develop repeatable playbooks, templates, and standards so the portfolio scales without losing quality.
  • Act as the event's point of contact for your programs — the person stakeholders trust to have it handled.
  • Anticipate risk, escalate early and appropriately, and keep programs on track when priorities shift. They will shift.

Executive Experiences

  • Design and deliver premium executive programs: advisory boards, curated hospitality, and the executive tracks inside our larger events.
  • Bring hospitality-grade instincts to a B2B environment — anticipatory, service-minded, and unwilling to let a detail slide — paired with the resourcefulness to build it yourself when there's no playbook yet.
  • Make sure every touchpoint in the executive journey is intentional, frictionless, and elevated. From the invitation to the follow-up.
  • Collaborate with our executive team, internal SMEs, and Product Marketing to build agendas and content that give C-level audiences genuine insight, not a product demo in a nicer room.
  • Coordinate executive and VIP participation end to end — briefing materials, prep, on-site handling, and thoughtful follow-through.
  • Represent Abnormal directly to senior customer executives and their teams with professionalism, situational awareness, and a premium service mindset. You are an ambassador of this brand at the highest levels.

Large Internal Events

  • Co-own the planning and delivery of Abnormal's largest internal moments — Sales Kickoff and President’s Club.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Marketing, and People to define objectives, build the agenda, and manage production, venue, travel, and on-site operations.
  • Treat our own people with the same experience standard we give customers. The internal moments are where culture gets made, and they deserve the same craft as the external ones.

Measurement & Impact

  • Define and track KPIs for every program: attendance, engagement, meetings, pipeline influence, customer participation, and ROI.
  • Deliver post-event reporting with real recommendations — what we repeat, what we kill, what we invest more in.
  • Use data and stakeholder feedback to continuously sharpen strategy, investment, and execution.
  • Keep event documentation and reporting accurate and accessible across the portfolio.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in strategic events, executive programs, or field marketing — including direct experience owning executive-level programs. Ideally in B2B technology, cybersecurity, SaaS, or another high-growth environment.
  • Proven ownership of complex, high-visibility owned events and executive programs from strategy through execution and analysis.
  • A premium experience mindset. You're obsessive about details, operationally excellent, and you build moments that people remember.
  • Strong program management chops: organized, proactive, structured, relentless about deadlines, and genuinely good at driving cross-functional work to an outcome.
  • Experience delivering large internal events such as Sales Kickoff, sales incentive or club trips, or company offsites.
  • Real budget, vendor, agency, and contract management experience across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Exceptional communication skills — polished agendas, briefing docs, and executive-facing comms that need no cleanup.
  • Executive maturity. You're comfortable and credible in a room full of senior leaders, internal or customer-side.
  • Composure under pressure. You can build the plan months out and solve the unexpected problem on-site in four minutes.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how events drive brand, customer relationships, and pipeline — and you make decisions accordingly.
  • Demonstrated use of AI to improve how you work: streamlining workflows, sharpening decisions, and creating leverage. We're an AI-native company and we expect our team to work like one.
  • Willingness to travel roughly 25%, primarily in North America.

Cybersecurity experience is a plus, not a requirement. What matters is executive acumen, judgment, attention to detail, and exceptional execution.

What Success Looks Like

  • Abnormal's event portfolio is delivered flawlessly, consistently, and at a standard people talk about afterward.
  • Executive programs create genuine relationships with the most influential security leaders in our market.
  • Sales, marketing, leadership, customers, and partners have an exceptional experience — and know exactly who to thank.
  • Budgets and resources are managed with discipline and transparency.
  • Every program has a clear measurement story and a defensible ROI.
  • Playbooks and standards exist that make the next event better than the last one.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$118,600—$170,500 USD

A Principal Software Engineer for JAVA is an associate at Creative Chaos who is mainly responsible for developing server applications of various software platforms including but not limited to writing Restful APIs to be consumed by client applications. A Principal Software Engineer makes sure that the functionality, security and performance of the server application is as per the design and is completely bug free. Principal engineers have a responsibility to lead a team of engineers, mentor team members through continuous training and guidance.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop, test, debug, document, and maintain the back-end services, models, processes, and databases that support the application
  • Participate in development team activities to ensure consistently high levels of quality and productivity
  • Deep and rapidly growing experience with cloud architectures: security, availability, microservices, consumption-based billing, designs for scalability
  • Stay up-to-date on new technologies and development techniques to improve application quality and construction efficiency
  • Embrace agile principles and support iterative processes to maximize the delivery of valuable software
  • Provides technical expertise and advice for complex assignments and/or projects. Works with staff, contractors, and vendors to meet Company MIS needs.

  • Provides project leadership; may manage small to medium projects.
  • Presents recommendations to management and provides guidance in selecting alternatives.
  • Serves as a resource to others regarding highly technical areas and provides expertise to department management and others outside department/function.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelors in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum has 8+ years professional experience in Java/Spring development, specifically developing commercial Spring MVC/Hibernate and AJAX web applications;
