jobs.title: EMR Platform Owner
jobs.excerpt: Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments.
jobs.description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 9 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

About Metro Vein Centers

Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing, multi-site specialty healthcare organization focused on delivering exceptional patient care through operational excellence, technology enablement, and scalable clinical systems.

We are modernizing our enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem to support the next phase of growth across clinical operations, patient experience, revenue cycle, analytics, and workflow automation.

We are seeking a highly operational, systems-oriented leader to serve as the long-term owner of our EMR platform and adjacent clinical systems infrastructure.

This is not a traditional healthcare IT administration role.

The ideal candidate thinks like a product owner and operator — someone who can continuously improve how care delivery functions through technology, workflows, automation, and operational design.

The Role

As the EMR Platform Owner, you will own the strategy, evolution, optimization, and governance of Metro Vein Centers’ enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem.

You will lead the organization’s EMR modernization initiative while serving as the long-term operational owner of the platform after implementation.

This role sits at the intersection of:

  • clinical operations,
  • provider experience,
  • revenue cycle,
  • systems architecture,
  • workflow optimization,
  • analytics,
  • and operational scalability.

You will partner closely with leadership across operations, clinical teams, billing, analytics, and technology to ensure the EMR functions as a scalable operational platform for the business.

Responsibilities

Platform Ownership & Strategy

  • Own the long-term roadmap for the enterprise EMR and clinical systems ecosystem
  • Define and continuously improve future-state workflows across clinical operations, scheduling, intake, documentation, billing, and patient engagement
  • Establish governance standards for EMR workflows, configurations, integrations, and operational change management
  • Evaluate platform capabilities, integrations, and optimization opportunities
  • Serve as the primary business owner for the EMR and related operational systems

EMR Modernization Leadership

  • Lead the organization’s EMR transition initiative from vendor selection through implementation and post-go-live optimization
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across operations, clinical teams, revenue cycle, analytics, and technology
  • Partner with external consultants, implementation vendors, and EMR partners
  • Drive implementation planning, migration readiness, workflow alignment, testing, adoption, and stabilization activities
  • Ensure operational continuity and provider adoption throughout the transition
  • Coordinate legacy EMR wind-down efforts, including transition planning, data archival needs, vendor communication, and post-conversion support.

Operational Workflow Optimization

  • Partner with clinical and operational leadership to improve provider workflows, clinic throughput, documentation efficiency, and operational consistency
  • Identify opportunities to reduce administrative friction and automate manual workflows
  • Collaborate with revenue cycle leadership to optimize authorizations, coding, billing, denial management, and eligibility workflows
  • Standardize workflows across clinics while balancing operational flexibility where appropriate
  • Develop KPI frameworks and operational reporting tied to platform performance

Systems & Data Ecosystem

  • Partner with analytics and engineering teams to support reporting, interoperability, and data governance initiatives
  • Manage relationships with EMR vendors and third-party integration partners
  • Support scalable onboarding of future clinics, providers, and acquisitions
  • Help shape long-term enterprise architecture decisions related to clinical systems and operational platforms
  • Own system administration and governance (in partnership with IT Director), including SOPs around user security access, role-based permissions, system updates, configuration changes, enhancement requests, and ongoing optimization to ensure platforms remain secure, compliant, and aligned with business needs.

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • Experience owning, leading, or optimizing EMR/EHR platforms in a multi-site ambulatory healthcare environment
  • Strong operational mindset with demonstrated experience improving workflows and systems adoption
  • Experience working cross-functionally with clinical operations, revenue cycle, analytics, and technical teams
  • Ability to translate operational challenges into scalable systems solutions
  • Experience leading or supporting complex healthcare technology implementations or transformations

Preferred Experience

  • Specialty practice or ambulatory care experience strongly preferred
  • Experience with EMR migrations or enterprise platform modernization initiatives
  • Experience in high-growth or multi-site healthcare organizations
  • Familiarity with healthcare operations KPIs, revenue cycle workflows, and provider productivity metrics
  • Experience working with integrations, APIs, reporting ecosystems, or operational analytics platforms

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Think in systems, workflows, and operational leverage
  • Enjoy solving ambiguous cross-functional problems
  • Can balance clinical, operational, financial, and technical priorities
  • Are equally comfortable working with executives, physicians, operators, analysts, and technical teams
  • Prefer building scalable operational platforms over maintaining legacy workflows
  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-growth environments
  • Bring a product-owner mentality to operational systems and platform governance

What This Role Is Not

This role is not:

  • a traditional EMR administrator role,
  • a helpdesk or infrastructure IT role,
  • or a pure project/program management function.

This role is intended to serve as the long-term operational owner of the organization’s clinical systems platform and care delivery workflows.

Why Join Metro Vein Centers

This role offers a rare opportunity to help shape the operational infrastructure of a rapidly scaling healthcare organization.

You will have direct influence over:

  • how providers deliver care,
  • how clinics operate,
  • how patients engage with the organization,
  • and how technology enables future growth across the enterprise.

You will help define the next generation of operational systems powering Metro Vein Centers.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (starts at $120,000) and benefits
  • High-growth environment with ownership and autonomy
  • Smart, collaborative, creative teammates
  • Real impact on business performance and patient experience

The Metro Vein Centers Difference

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

A team united by purpose.

Our values guide everything we do:

  • Patients First, Always – Every interaction should make our patients feel valued, heard, and cared for.
  • Stronger Together – Teamwork and collaboration drive our success. We lift each other up to deliver the best for our patients.
  • A Can-Do Spirit – We meet every challenge with positivity, flexibility, and problem-solving energy.
  • Results That Make a Difference – We’re driven to improve lives through meaningful, measurable outcomes.
  • Commitment to Growth – We invest in our people, fostering advancement and professional development at every level.

Metro Vein Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Legal & Compliance Notice:
Metro Vein Centers complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including those related to nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and pay transparency. Where specific disclosures or postings are required by law, we provide this information as part of our hiring process or upon request.

Our Newest Opportunity:

Summary:

The Vendor Portfolio Manager leads the Vendor Management Office (VMO) and is accountable for the design, governance, maturation, and enterprise adoption of OneDigital’s vendor management operating model. The role establishes frameworks, technology, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration to manage third-party vendor relationships across their lifecycle while preserving appropriate business ownership and functional decision rights. The VMO is not a traditional source-to-pay or centralized procurement function; it provides the governance, visibility, standards, tools, and coordination needed to support business-led vendor decisions and lifecycle management. The role supports a diverse portfolio of transactional and contractual vendor relationships representing more than $200M in annual spend and more than 5,000 vendor relationships across the enterprise. Through strategic leadership and hands-on execution, the Vendor Portfolio Manager ensures vendor management practices are scalable, consistently applied, and aligned to enterprise objectives.

Partnering with business leaders and stakeholders, this role strengthens vendor governance, optimizes vendor investments, manages escalations, and supports enterprise growth through M&A activity and organic growth initiatives. The Vendor Portfolio Manager also oversees VMO team activities while remaining engaged in core vendor management, governance, risk, contractual, and operational work. In this capacity, the role delivers data-driven recommendations, guides vendor decisions, improves visibility, reduces unnecessary cost and duplication, supports regulatory compliance, and creates measurable organizational value.

The ideal candidate brings strategic leadership, vendor management expertise, and analytical judgement. They excel at solving complex business challenges, building consensus among stakeholder groups, and influencing decisions across a matrixed enterprise. Success requires balancing business enablement, financial value, risk management, compliance, and practical implementation while advancing a scalable, technology-enabled VMO.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

VMO Strategy Leadership

  • Lead the Vendor Management Office (VMO), including strategy, operating models, policies, governance standards, service delivery, technology roadmap, organizational goals, and performance metrics
  • Develop and mature vendor management, contract governance, and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) capabilities while ensuring clear ownership, accountability, and decision rights across the organization
  • Lead, coach, and develop the VMO team; establish priorities, workload management practices, training plans, service expectations, and quality standards
  • Prepare executive reporting, business cases, investment recommendations, operating updates, and risk or capacity escalations supporting strategic decision-making and program maturity

Vendor Lifecycle Oversight

  • Establish and govern risk-based vendor lifecycle requirements, including intake, onboarding, due diligence, reassessment, performance management, issue resolution, offboarding, and record retention
  • Oversee the organization’s Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) program and vendor risk governance activities, partnering with Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders to assess and support mitigation of vendor-related risks while preserving subject-matter ownership within each function
  • Ensure vendor and engagement records, approvals, findings, agreements, and supporting documentation remain complete, defensible, audit-ready, and aligned with regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements

Vendor Relationships & Contract Governance

  • Lead or advise business owners on sourcing approaches, commercial structures, contract considerations, negotiation readiness, and total cost and value realization opportunities
  • Lead or support complex vendor negotiations, escalations, and relationship matters in partnership with Legal, business leadership, and other stakeholders
  • Maintain governance standards for vendor agreements, including visibility, renewal management, service expectations, commercial obligations, and vendor accountability
  • Foster productive relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders while supporting resolution of performance, operational, contractual, compliance, and service-related challenges

Portfolio Optimization & Value Realization

  • Create visibility into a diverse enterprise vendor portfolio, including transactional and contractual relationships, with insight into ownership, utilization, contract commitments, criticality, performance, risk exposure, and portfolio concentration
  • Identify and lead vendor rationalization, consolidation, standardization, cost optimization, preferred supplier, and value realization initiatives to improve operational effectiveness and reduce unnecessary spend
  • Establish governance and integration frameworks for acquired vendor portfolios, partnering with M&A, IT, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to support vendor transition, risk assessment, ownership assignment, and lifecycle integration activities
  • Deliver data-driven recommendations and portfolio insights that support enterprise growth objectives, operational efficiency, and risk-informed decision-making

Technology, Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the business design, strategic direction, implementation, and continuous improvement of VMO technologies, including workflow automation, reporting platforms, vendor management systems, self-service capabilities, and AI-enabled tools
  • Establish vendor data governance standards, reporting requirements, performance metrics, and system-of-record expectations providing visibility into portfolio health, lifecycle activity, risk, spend, vendor performance, and organizational value
  • Drive continuous improvement through process optimization, stakeholder feedback, analytics, automation, and technology-enabled solutions that enhance the business and vendor experience, improve data quality, and reduce administrative burden

Qualifications, Skills and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, risk management, supply chain management, finance, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in vendor management, third-party risk management, contract governance, supplier management, or a related field, preferably within a large, multi-location company or one with significant M&A activity.
  • Professional background in highly regulated industries, such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or other environments with complex regulatory, compliance, and audit requirements, preferred.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, negotiation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
  • Self-starter with strong critical thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and evolving environments.
  • Experience evaluating, designing, implementing, or optimizing business systems, workflow automation, reporting solutions, AI-enabled tools, and technology-driven process improvements
  • Familiarity with vendor management, third-party risk management (TPRM), contract lifecycle management (CLM), supplier relationship management (SRM), accounting systems, analytics, and business intelligence tools such as Onspring, Smartsheet, Excel, SimpleDocs, Stampli, Microsoft F&O, and Power BI.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple efforts simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing team members while establishing priorities, performance expectations, and service standards

Other:

  • Remote position with option to be in office depending on location (Atlanta, GA or East Coast preferred). Must be willing to travel on occasion.

Pay Range: $110,000-130,000

jobs.description:
Über NETSHAKE

Deutschlands E-Commerce-Incubator Nr. 1 und TÜV-zertifizierter Shopify Premier Partner – Top 1 % weltweit. 26 Jahre am Markt, über 1.600 Projekte, Standorte in Stuttgart und Dubai. Wir sind AI-First: Unsere Leads sind KI-vorqualifiziert, unser Vertrieb läuft über Close CRM mit Power Dialer. Du telefonierst nicht ins Blaue – du telefonierst mit System.

Worum es geht

Du bist die erste Stimme, die unsere Wunschkunden von NETSHAKE hören. Vier Stunden am Tag machst du Opening Calls mit tollen E-Commerce-Händlern und legst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter.

Nicht irgendwelche Termine. Termine, bei denen der Händler weiß, warum er im Gespräch sitzt, was NETSHAKE macht und warum es sich lohnt. Quantität bringt dich hier nicht weiter – Qualität schon.

Aufgaben

  • Du telefonierst 4 Stunden täglich KI-vorqualifizierte Leads aus dem Power Dialer ab
  • Du führst jedes Gespräch entlang unseres Gesprächsleitfadens: souveräner Einstieg, Interesse wecken, qualifizieren, ob es passt
  • Du behandelst Einwände nach unserem Einwandbehandlungs-Leitfaden. „Keine Zeit“, „kein Bedarf“, „schick mal was“ sind für dich der Beginn des Gesprächs
  • Du legst qualifizierte Termine für unsere Setter und dokumentierst sauber im CRM
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass jeder Termin, der von dir kommt, auch stattfindet

Qualifikation

  • Du bist hungrig. Du willst gewinnen, dich beweisen und in deinen Skills verbessern
  • Du gehst ans Telefon, um zu gewinnen. Ein „Nein“ spornt dich an, statt dich zu bremsen
  • Du bist ergebnisgetrieben und zählst am Abend, was du erreicht hast
  • Du führst Gespräche selbstbewusst und direkt, übernimmst die Führung und bringst den Gesprächspartner zur Entscheidung
  • Du beherrschst Einwandbehandlung und hast schon in Telesales, Kaltakquise, Terminierung oder Kundenservice telefoniert
  • Du hast einen Qualitätsanspruch: Lieber drei Termine, die halten, als zehn, die platzen
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und diszipliniert und bist 4 Stunden täglich fest am Telefon
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachler-Niveau (Voraussetzung, nicht verhandelbar)
  • Ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, Headset

Benefits

  • Stundenhonorar + Performance-Boni: Du bekommst ein festes Stundenhonorar – und zusätzlich Boni für jeden Termin. Der Bonus richtet sich nach der Qualität des Termins, nicht nur nach der Anzahl. Wer gute Termine legt, verdient deutlich mehr.
  • 100 % remote – weltweit: Du arbeitest, wo du willst. Lissabon, Bali, Berlin oder das zu Hause – alles, was du brauchst, ist ein ruhiger Platz, stabiles Internet und ein Headset. Kein Büro, kein Pendeln, keine Anwesenheitspflicht
  • Freiheit mit klarem Rahmen: 4 Stunden am Tag, fest getaktet – der Rest des Tages gehört dir. Ideal neben Studium, Familie, Reisen oder anderem Job
  • Keine Kaltakquise ins Leere sondern gezielt: KI-vorqualifizierte Leads, Power Dialer, fertige Gesprächsleitfäden. Du telefonierst, das System macht den Rest.
  • Onboarding und Training: Du bekommst Skripte, Einwandbehandlung und Coaching – und ein Team, das dir den Rücken freihält.
  • Karriereweg im Vertrieb: Wer als Opener liefert, wird Setter. Wer als Setter liefert, wird Closer. Der Weg ist offen, sofern du willst.
  • Ein Produkt, das man gern verkauft: Shopify-Händler, die wachsen wollen – und eine Agentur, die das nachweislich liefert.
  • Karriereweg statt Sackgasse – wenn du willst: Du startest mit 4 Stunden am Tag – und wächst mit deinen Ergebnissen. Wer liefert, bekommt auf Wunsch mehr Stunden, mehr Verantwortung, mehr Einkommen. Bei guter Zusammenarbeit sprechen wir gern über eine Festanstellung – in deutschen oder internationalen Strukturen, je nachdem, wo du lebst und wohin du willst. Und der Weg geht weiter: Opener → Setter → Closer. Das ist keine Voraussetzung, sondern ein Angebot: Wer bei 4 Stunden bleiben will, bleibt bei 4 Stunden. Wer mehr will, bekommt die Tür geöffnet

Passt das?

Wenn du gern telefonierst, mit einem „Nein“ umgehen kannst und den Anspruch hast, Termine zu legen, die etwas wert sind – bewirb dich.

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.

jobs.excerpt: We are hiring an Agentic Solutions Architect to design production-grade agentic solutions on our internal platform across multiple delivery squads.
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Agentic Solutions Architect to design production-grade agentic solutions on our internal platform across multiple delivery squads. This role connects business needs, product intent, and engineering execution: you will understand the problem to solve, shape viable options, make and communicate tradeoffs, be hands on keyboard coding, manage a team of engineers, and guide squads toward secure, observable, reusable, and supportable outcomes.

You will architect across several squads rather than serving as the architect for a single use case. You will partner with Product, Program, Tech Leads, engineers, security, and business stakeholders to ensure solution architectures align with the platform standards and broader engineering strategy.

What You'll Do

    • Partner with team leadership and business stakeholders to understand goals, workflows, users, constraints, and success measures.

    • Help determine whether an agentic solution is appropriate, or whether a deterministic workflow, existing capability, or no-AI solution is better.

    • Be able to challenge the status quo and look for simplicity, scalability, and staged solutions that deliver incremental value when needed.

    • Translate business needs into technical requirements, scope boundaries, delivery roadmaps, architectural options, measurable outcomes, and implementation plans.

    • Explain technical implications and communicate tradeoffs across scope, cost, quality, latency, security, risk, and delivery speed.

    • Own solution architecture for a portfolio of use cases and agentic applications delivered by several squads within a larger delivery organization.

    • Map end-to-end workflows, trigger events, human approvals, system interactions, failure paths, and operational handoffs.

    • Define agent package structure, task graphs, orchestration patterns, and the division of responsibility between agents, deterministic code, tools, and platform services.
      Identify required systems, data sources, outputs, APIs, integrations, tools, and MCP capabilities.

    • Work with partners to ensure dependencies are accounted for and managed across the portfolio of solutions in the role’s purview.

    • Produce architecture diagrams, decision records, implementation guidance, acceptance criteria, and nonfunctional requirements.

    • Manage cross-squad dependencies, technical debt, duplicate capabilities, and opportunities for reusable patterns, templates, connectors, and reference implementations.

    • Collaborate with delivery teams to translate architecture into work packages, estimates, quality criteria, and delivery plans.

    • Be hands on keyboard to guide and work with the teams and understand solutions to a granular level.

    • Apply architecture standards, approval controls, guardrails, and governance requirements throughout delivery.

    • Work with leadership to maintain solution architecture across teams for technical direction, engineering standards, capacity, and risk posture.

    • Support developer onboarding and architecture education across squads.

    • Coordinate decisions and dependencies across product, engineering, security, data, integrations, and business teams.

    • Communicate architecture status, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs to technical and executive audiences.

    • Directly manage engineers executing across multiple small, focused product squads.

What You'll Bring

    Required experience

    • AWS and cloud-hosted foundation models or agent platforms, such as Amazon Bedrock or AgentCore, or equivalent technologies.

    • Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, REST or GraphQL APIs, event-driven systems, serverless or containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code.

    • Significant experience in software architecture, solutions architecture, technical leadership, or a similar role designing and delivering enterprise systems.

    • Experience architecting and shipping production AI, generative AI, agentic, conversational, or intelligent-automation solutions.

    • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including orchestration, tool use, RAG, model selection, prompt and policy controls, human-in-the-loop approval, state and memory, evaluation, and fallback behavior.

    • Experience integrating enterprise systems through APIs, events, connectors, workflow engines, or MCP-style tool patterns.

    • Strong understanding of identity, authorization, data access, privacy, auditability, and secure-by-default design.

    • Demonstrated ability to influence multiple teams or squads without relying solely on formal authority.

    • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain complex architecture and tradeoffs to business stakeholders and executives.

    • Experience creating architecture diagrams, ADRs, technical requirements, nonfunctional requirements, and implementation guidance.

    Preferred experience

    • Experience with enterprise SaaS and business systems such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or similar platforms.

    • Establishing reusable architecture standards, reference architectures, developer patterns, or platform governance.

    • Leading architecture reviews involving security, compliance, privacy, or production risk.

    • Relevant cloud, security, AI, or architecture certifications. Certifications are helpful but are not a substitute for demonstrated production experience.

    • Experience coordinating and managing the work of engineers against a timeline.

What Success Looks Like

    • Multiple squads can move independently while following coherent architecture patterns and shared platform standards.

    • Business stakeholders understand solution options, key tradeoffs, and expected outcomes before significant implementation investment.

    • Each solution has clear boundaries, documented decisions, nonfunctional requirements, security controls, operational ownership, and a credible path to production.

    • Reusable capabilities are adopted across squads instead of repeatedly rebuilt as bespoke solutions where possible.

    • Risks, dependencies, exceptions, and technical debt are visible early and actively managed.

    • Solutions deliver measurable business value while meeting expectations for quality, safety, reliability, observability, and cost.

    • Squad leaders share a clear view of how use-case architecture supports platform engineering goals.

jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer (f/m/x) to join our App squad. In this role, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of scalable backend services that power refurbed's mobile app and marketplace. Just as importantly, you understand how a native mobile app consumes those services - so you can guide backend decisions, your own and those of other squads, to fit the app's needs and constraints. You will work as part of a cross-functional product squad, collaborating closely with other engineers, product managers, designers, and business members to deliver robust, reliable, and high-performance solutions that enhance the experience of both our customers and our sellers.

Our technology stack is built on proven, modern, and open-source technologies. On the backend, we primarily use Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, and RabbitMQ, with Node.js / TypeScript powering a number of app-facing services. Our mobile app is built in React Native + Expo, and on the web frontend we leverage Vue.js, Alpine.js, and Tailwind CSS. Our infrastructure runs on Google Cloud Platform, orchestrated with Kubernetes, ensuring reliability and scalability at every layer.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • You have 7+ years experience designing and building scalable backend services in a modern production environment
  • You have strong proficiency in Go and deep understanding of distributed systems and service-oriented architecture
  • You are comfortable with JavaScript/TypeScript, or confident you can pick up Node.js quickly - with strong Go fundamentals, we expect the rest to come easily. Existing Node.js experience is a plus.
  • You've worked on a team that builds and maintains a native mobile app. You don't need to write native code yourself, but you have real exposure to how mobile apps consume backend services and understand the constraints and caveats they introduce (API design for mobile, versioning and backwards compatibility, release cycles, latency, offline behaviour). You can spot when a backend decision won't fit the app and flag it early.
  • You are well-versed in SQL and relational database design
  • You have general knowledge of the frontend world, and are able to perform basic tasks in our frontend apps
  • You're a self-starter with strong ownership, initiative, and the ability to quickly learn and navigate complex systems
  • You're open-minded and communicate with clarity, directness, and respect
  • You value humility, are low-ego, and thrive in a collaborative, transparent culture
  • You have excellent English skills and you are based in a European time zone.
  • You are curious and eager to experiment with new and better ways of developing software, whether it's a new framework, the latest AI tool, or developing a new practice
  • A degree in Computer Science (or a related field) or equivalent work experience is desired as it provides a strong foundation for tackling the complex challenges we work on.
  • Bonus: you're comfortable operating beyond your own squad - reviewing designs and guiding other engineers whose work touches the mobile app. This role has room to grow into a broader technical leadership scope for the right person.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Design, build, and maintain our core APIs and backend services that power the mobile app and marketplace
  • Own the operations and the monitoring of production systems
  • Be the mobile-aware voice in backend decisions across squads: review designs and API changes, yours and other teams', to make sure they fit the needs and constraints of our mobile app, and flag caveats early
  • Integrate third-party systems and APIs into our platform
  • Own design and implementation of new features and services
  • Identify best practices and create/suggest standards to be used by whole engineering department
  • Documents and demonstrates solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  • Contribute to sustaining refurbed engineering culture by mentoring more junior colleagues and onboarding new joiners
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Proactively offer insights and presents achievements and results in relevant meetings
  • Occasionally propagate your backend changes to frontend

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

  • Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!
  • We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.
  • You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!
  • No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

  • You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.
  • We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.
  • We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

  • We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊
  • We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.
  • You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See for further insights!

Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com 99.600 colaboradores no mundo, contamos com 2.650 escritórios e laboratórios. Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. As our CRM & Lifecycle Manager, you'll own key parts of the customer lifecycle with our Head of CLM, across strategy, data, automation and execution. You'll spot where engagement can improve, design new journeys and experiments, and build the workflows that bring them to life.

You'll also help shape how the CLM itself works. Successful experiments become repeatable systems, and work that doesn't need a person gets automated.

Your edge is building fast and measuring everything. You use AI daily for research, analysis, segmentation, copy, personalisation and testing, so running several markets does not mean several times the work.

  • Test what AI makes possible. Experiment with personalisation, content and segmentation, measure the results and take what works into production.

  • Build for scale. Create reusable journeys and processes, ready for new markets as the group grows.

  • Work across the business. Partner with product, data, engineering and marketing on the customer experience and the infrastructure behind it.

Requirements

You will thrive here if you

  • Have the mindset of a hands on builder rather than a delegator.

  • Believe process serves outcomes, not the other way around.

  • Value clarity, candour and collaboration.

  • Take a roadmap and run with it, without needing daily direction.

  • Are excited by the challenge of scaling one of Europe's most impactful consumer marketplaces.

  • A profitable, growing business rather than a slide deck.

  • A diverse team of more than 100 colleagues across the world.

  • Competitive compensation.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As the Director of Account Based Marketing (ABM), you will lead the strategy, build-out, and performance of Power Digital's ABM discipline across the B2B portfolio. You will own the playbooks, platform strategy, and cross-functional orchestration that turn target account lists into pipeline and revenue — serving as the senior-most ABM voice for clients and the internal authority on intent data, account scoring, and multi-channel orchestration.

You will partner closely with the B2B account directors to translate GTM plans into executable ABM programs, and with Paid Media, Content, Creative, and Email/Lifecycle teams to ensure account-based campaigns are coordinated rather than siloed. This is a builder-and-operator role: you're expected to both architect ABM frameworks and get into the platforms yourself when it matters.

You'll manage the connective tissue between strategy and execution — ensuring account selection, tiering, and intent signals actually drive media, content, and outreach decisions, and that performance reporting ties ABM activity back to pipeline and revenue, not just engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end ABM strategy and delivery across the B2B client portfolio — account selection and tiering, intent signal strategy, and multi-channel orchestration
  • Serve as Power Digital's primary ABM subject matter expert and Account Director for the Strategy and ABM teams
  • Build and refine ABM audits, playbooks, and GTM plans for clients in partnership with the B2B Client Strategy team
  • Architect and manage 6Sense and Demandbase implementations, including intent data integration, account scoring models, and predictive analytics workflows
  • Translate intent and engagement data into actionable account tiers and campaign triggers for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams
  • Lead cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to ensure ABM campaigns are unified rather than siloed
  • Identify efficiency opportunities in the delivery of ABM products and collaborate toward implementation
  • Support Revenue and Appraisal teams on complex GTM and ABM strategies for new and expanded business opportunities
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM measurement and reporting
  • Present ABM strategy and performance directly to clients; lead discovery discussions on account-based approaches
  • Mentor and upskill Strategy and ABM team members on platform proficiency and account-based methodology
  • Own the ABM measurement framework — pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and velocity through funnel stages

Role Requirements:

  • Mandatory: hands-on proficiency with 6Sense, Demandbase, or equivalent ABM/intent data platforms — this is a non-negotiable requirement for the role, not a nice-to-have
  • 7+ years in B2B marketing strategy or ABM, in-house or in-agency, with demonstrated ownership of account-based programs end to end
  • Strategic knowledge of core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, and HubSpot, and how they integrate with ABM platforms
  • Deep understanding of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering — and how to operationalize them across channels
  • Comfort and ease presenting strategy to clients and leading discovery discussions
  • Strong project management skills; able to run multiple client ABM programs concurrently
  • Strategic understanding of clients' business metrics and pipeline mechanics, and how ABM contributes to them
  • Team-oriented and collaborative; comfortable leading cross-functional teams without direct authority
  • Agency experience valued but not required

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net MRR across B2B ABM / Strategy portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Monthly Service Expansion pipeline generation
  • Power Circuit Certification (annual)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Ensure B2B/ABM clients receive the highest-quality strategic work, grounded in intent data and account-level insight
  • Clear, direct, and radically candid communication with internal and external stakeholders
  • Client value — has your work provided new insight, confirmed a course of action, or outlined a clear path forward

Benefits & Perks:

  • Base salary paid in USD + commission opportunities
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • Healthcare stipend: $50/month to support your healthcare or insurance costs
  • National Holidays + 2 Mental Health Recharge Days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)
  • Quarterly awards including prize money and recognition for outstanding performance
  • Opportunities to be involved in company DEI initiatives

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Please be aware of fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers from suspicious sources. These engagements may be an attempt to obtain private information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Power Digital does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page at . If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any messaging behalf of Power Digital, please send us an email at before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

About the Role

Welo Data is seeking experienced linguists to support a synthetic data generation program for a leading technology client. In this role, you will perform A/B preference testing of machine-generated translations from English into Farsi, helping to evaluate and improve the quality of AI-generated content.

As a Translation Validator, you will independently review an English source document alongside two machine-generated translations (Variant A and Variant B), select the preferred translation, and provide a written justification for your choice. Each sample is reviewed by three independent validators working in a blind process.

Project Details

  • Job Title: Translation Validation - Farsi
  • Location: Remote (India)
  • Commitment: 2 weeks
  • Employment Type: Freelance Contract
  • Pay Rate: $3.50 USD/Hour

What You’ll Do

  • Review English source documents alongside two machine-generated Farsitranslations.
  • Evaluate both variants based on accuracy, fluency, and overall translation quality.
  • Select the preferred translation and provide a clear written justification for your assessment.
  • Review audio files and their corresponding transcriptions, evaluating accuracy, completeness, and overall quality.
  • Assess both transcription quality and audio quality according to project guidelines.
  • Complete assigned samples independently and within established timelines.
  • Adhere strictly to project and client guidelines

Requirements:

  • Native-level fluency in Farsi (written and spoken).
  • Strong written communication skills in the target language.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Background in linguistics, translation, or language quality assessment preferred.
  • Ability to work independently with high attention to detail and consistency.
  • Familiarity with Romanized script conventions for the relevant language is a plus (for transliteration tasks).

✨ Limitless Flexibility 

Project-based opportunities that fit your availability. Choose when and how much you want to contribute—fully remote, with complete autonomy. 
🌱 Limitless Growth 
Optional access to AI and Large Language Model workshops designed specifically for professionals like you. No coding required—just your expertise. 
🌍 Limitless Support 
Be part of a global contributor community with responsive guidance and support. 
💡 Real Impact 
Apply your expertise in the Legal field to influence the AI systems shaping the future of your industry—while collaborating with data professionals and expanding your skills.

How to Apply?

Apply now by answering a few quick questions to join our database and become part of our growing community.

About Welo Data

Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.
At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

jobs.excerpt: Vice President Medical - Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) Location: Remote (Europe) /Horgen, Switzerland / United Kingdom Reporting to: SVP Development Operations Company ContextNumab Therapeutics AG is a Swiss‑headquartered biotechnology company based in Horgen, Zurich canton, dedicated to developing multi‑specific antibody‑based immunotherapies for cancer and inflammation.
jobs.description:
Vice President Medical - Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)

Location: Remote (Europe) /Horgen, Switzerland / United Kingdom

Reporting to: SVP Development Operations

Company Context

Numab Therapeutics AG is a Swiss‑headquartered biotechnology company based in Horgen, Zurich canton, dedicated to developing multi‑specific antibody‑based immunotherapies for cancer and inflammation. Using its proprietary λ‑Cap™ and MATCH™ technology platforms, Numab designs and engineers multi‑specific antibodies that combine best‑in‑class potency, stability, and pharmacokinetic properties.

The company has built a broad and differentiated pipeline of in‑house programs across immunology and oncology, and has established multiple collaborations with leading global pharmaceutical partners—underlining the scalability and external validation of its platform and business model. In 2024 the company completed a major transaction with Johnson & Johnson through the sale of its subsidiary (Yellow Jersey Therapeutics) which included rights to NM26‑2198 in a deal valued at approximately USD 1.25 billion. In early 2025, the Series C fundraising was extended to CHF 180 million to support several first- and best-in-class programs.

With a headcount of around 80 employees, Numab now enters an exciting phase of development.

Role Purpose

The Vice President, Medical will play a dual role spanning Clinical Development and Medical Affairs.

Internally, they will provide medical leadership for the ongoing development of Numab's IBD programme, contributing to clinical strategy, trial design, data interpretation, and development planning. A key focus will be helping shape the design of early phase studies in patients and identifying innovative approaches that maximize the opportunity to demonstrate meaningful clinical differentiation in a competitive therapeutic landscape.

Externally, they will establish and maintain trusted relationships with leading experts in IBD and related fields, helping ensure that Numab's science, data, and therapeutic approach are understood within the broader context of disease biology and evolving treatment paradigms. The individual will serve as a credible scientific ambassador for the company and play an important role in shaping external scientific dialogue surrounding both the programme and the future role of tri-specific antibodies in IBD.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Development

  • Contribute to the overall clinical development strategy for Numab's IBD programme.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Translational Medicine, Regulatory Affairs, and Executive Leadership to advance development plans.
  • Provide medical leadership and strategic input into Phase IIb study design and future development strategy.
  • Identify creative and scientifically rigorous approaches to trial design, endpoint selection, patient segmentation, biomarker integration, and evidence generation.
  • Incorporate insights from clinical practice, scientific experts, and the competitive landscape to optimize development plans.
  • Evaluate emerging clinical and translational data and provide strategic recommendations to guide programme decisions.
  • Contribute to protocol development, protocol amendments, investigator-facing scientific materials, and study governance discussions.
  • Support benefit-risk assessment and interpretation of efficacy and safety findings throughout development.

Medical Affairs & External Scientific Leadership

  • Lead external scientific engagement activities for Numab's IBD programme.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key opinion leaders, investigators, academic experts, and scientific societies.
  • Facilitate scientific exchange regarding disease biology, treatment paradigms, emerging evidence, and the potential role of novel therapeutic approaches in IBD.
  • Help establish and communicate the scientific narrative surrounding Numab's programme and its differentiated therapeutic approach.
  • Generate external insights that inform development strategy, evidence generation plans, and future positioning.
  • Represent Numab at scientific congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, and other external forums.
  • Contribute to publications, scientific communications, and educational initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted scientific representative for the company with clinical, scientific, and investment stakeholders.

Key Qualifications & Experience

  • MD or equivalent medical qualification.
  • Significant experience within biotechnology or pharmaceutical drug development.
  • Deep expertise in inflammatory bowel disease, with an established reputation and network within the IBD community.
  • Experience spanning both Medical Affairs and Clinical Development.
  • Strong understanding of inflammatory pathways, disease pathophysiology, biologic therapies, and evolving treatment approaches in IBD.
  • Demonstrated experience contributing to clinical study design, development strategy, and interpretation of clinical data.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence scientific discussions with external experts through credible, evidence-based scientific exchange.

Key Competencies

  • Challenges assumptions and contributes to decision-making
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to translate scientific insights into development and business decisions.
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills.

Posting details

Please note that applications that do not meet the requirements will not be considered.

Application deadline is Thursday 2nd July.

Numab are based in Horgen, Switzerland. This role can be conducted remotely from Europe, with occasional travel to the Numab office.

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

As the Director of Account Based Marketing (ABM), you will lead the strategy, build-out, and performance of Power Digital's ABM discipline across the B2B portfolio. You will own the playbooks, platform strategy, and cross-functional orchestration that turn target account lists into pipeline and revenue — serving as the senior-most ABM voice for clients and the internal authority on intent data, account scoring, and multi-channel orchestration.

You will partner closely with the B2B account directors to translate GTM plans into executable ABM programs, and with Paid Media, Content, Creative, and Email/Lifecycle teams to ensure account-based campaigns are coordinated rather than siloed. This is a builder-and-operator role: you're expected to both architect ABM frameworks and get into the platforms yourself when it matters.

You'll manage the connective tissue between strategy and execution — ensuring account selection, tiering, and intent signals actually drive media, content, and outreach decisions, and that performance reporting ties ABM activity back to pipeline and revenue, not just engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end ABM strategy and delivery across the B2B client portfolio — account selection and tiering, intent signal strategy, and multi-channel orchestration
  • Serve as Power Digital's primary ABM subject matter expert and Account Director for the Strategy and ABM teams
  • Build and refine ABM audits, playbooks, and GTM plans for clients in partnership with the B2B Client Strategy team
  • Architect and manage 6Sense and Demandbase implementations, including intent data integration, account scoring models, and predictive analytics workflows
  • Translate intent and engagement data into actionable account tiers and campaign triggers for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams
  • Lead cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to ensure ABM campaigns are unified rather than siloed
  • Identify efficiency opportunities in the delivery of ABM products and collaborate toward implementation
  • Support Revenue and Appraisal teams on complex GTM and ABM strategies for new and expanded business opportunities
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM measurement and reporting
  • Present ABM strategy and performance directly to clients; lead discovery discussions on account-based approaches
  • Mentor and upskill Strategy and ABM team members on platform proficiency and account-based methodology
  • Own the ABM measurement framework — pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and velocity through funnel stages

Role Requirements:

  • Mandatory: hands-on proficiency with 6Sense, Demandbase, or equivalent ABM/intent data platforms — this is a non-negotiable requirement for the role, not a nice-to-have
  • 7+ years in B2B marketing strategy or ABM, in-house or in-agency, with demonstrated ownership of account-based programs end to end
  • Strategic knowledge of core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, and HubSpot, and how they integrate with ABM platforms
  • Deep understanding of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering — and how to operationalize them across channels
  • Comfort and ease presenting strategy to clients and leading discovery discussions
  • Strong project management skills; able to run multiple client ABM programs concurrently
  • Strategic understanding of clients' business metrics and pipeline mechanics, and how ABM contributes to them
  • Team-oriented and collaborative; comfortable leading cross-functional teams without direct authority

  • Clear, direct, and radically candid communication with internal and external stakeholders
  • Client value — has your work provided new insight, confirmed a course of action, or outlined a clear path forward

  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm
  • Ongoing employee development programs for personal and professional growth (Hedgehog and Vital 5s)

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are:We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As an ABM Strategist, you will support the Director of Account Based Marketing in building, running, and optimizing account-based programs across Power Digital's B2B portfolio. You are the person in the platforms daily — building account lists, monitoring intent signals, and keeping campaigns and reporting accurate so the Director can focus on strategy and client relationships.

You will work hands-on in tools like 6Sense and Demandbase to maintain target account lists, segment and score accounts, and surface intent signals that inform what Paid Media, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams do next. This role is equal parts platform execution and strategic thinking — you're expected to not just pull the data, but understand what it means and flag it before someone else has to ask.

You'll partner closely with the Director of ABM on playbook development and client-facing materials, and coordinate directly with channel teams to make sure account tiering and intent data are actually driving campaign decisions, not just sitting in a dashboard.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, maintain, and continuously refine target account lists, tiering, and scoring models in 6Sense and Demandbase
  • Monitor intent data and account engagement signals daily; flag movement and surface insights to the Director of ABM before they become client questions
  • Support the Director of ABM in developing ABM audits, playbooks, and GTM plans for clients
  • Translate account tiers and intent signals into campaign briefs and targeting inputs for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams
  • Coordinate with channel teams to confirm account-based campaigns are executing against the intended tiering and messaging strategy
  • Own ABM reporting and dashboards; track pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and movement through funnel stages
  • Support cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to keep ABM campaigns unified
  • Assist Revenue and Appraisal teams with account and market research for new and expanded business opportunities
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM strategy and reporting
  • Join client calls and discovery discussions to represent ABM performance and platform data; build toward leading these independently

Role Requirements:

  • Mandatory: hands-on working proficiency with 6Sense, Demandbase, or an equivalent ABM/intent data platform
  • 2–4 years in B2B marketing, marketing operations, or ABM, in-house or in-agency
  • Comfortable working in core B2B Martech such as Salesforce, Marketo, or HubSpot
  • Working knowledge of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering, with a desire to go deeper on the strategy behind them
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting data without hand-holding
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate platform data into a takeaway a channel lead or client can act on
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage account data and reporting across multiple clients concurrently
  • Team-oriented and collaborative, with the confidence to flag issues or opportunities to more senior stakeholders
  • Agency experience valued but not required

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Net MRR across B2B ABM / Strategy portfolio
  • Client NPS (8+ avg)
  • Delivery of all work within agreed-upon deadlines
  • Accuracy and freshness of account tiering, scoring and intent data across assigned clients

Most Important Things (MITs)

Req ID:388184

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Associate Director, Vendor Management - Remote to join our team in Burnaby, British Columbia (CA-BC), Canada (CA).

Associate Director, Vendor Management

Position Summary

The Senior Hardware Procurement & Vendor Management Lead is responsible for overseeing end-to-end procurement, sourcing, vendor management, and hardware lifecycle activities for enterprise clients. The role will manage procurement operations across PC and end-user computing hardware, working closely with OEMs, distributors, resellers, Procurement, Commercial, Finance, Service Management, and client stakeholders.

This position combines strategic procurement, supplier management, hardware lifecycle planning, financial oversight, and client engagement. The successful candidate will ensure hardware requirements are met efficiently and cost-effectively while balancing client demand, inventory levels, supply chain considerations, service quality, and long-term technology roadmaps.

The role requires a strong understanding of B2B indirect procurement, hardware sourcing, vendor negotiations, managed services environments, and enterprise client management.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement & Strategic Sourcing

  • Manage and oversee day-to-day procurement activities, including requisitions, purchase orders, order fulfillment, and vendor coordination with OEMs and suppliers.
  • Lead the sourcing and quoting process for PC and end-user computing equipment, ensuring clients receive the best combination of price, quality, availability, and value.
  • Partner with Procurement leadership to manage the end-to-end procurement process and ensure compliance with established policies, controls, and commercial agreements.
  • Review supplier pricing, catalogue pricing, invoices, and payment requirements to ensure accuracy and alignment with contracted services and agreed pricing.
  • Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process improvement, and procurement efficiency.
  • Support the development and evaluation of RFPs, RFQs, supplier agreements, and procurement strategies.

Hardware Lifecycle & Roadmap Management

  • Establish and manage hardware roadmaps for Health Authorities (HAs) and provincial environments, including timelines for device transitions, refreshes, last buys, and retirement.
  • Coordinate the transition to new hardware platforms and retirement of legacy devices while minimizing operational disruption.
  • Ensure new hardware standards and associated knowledge base articles (KBAs) are established and maintained to support efficient service delivery.
  • Gather key hardware decision points and recommendations from HA stakeholders and communicate financial impacts, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Evaluate options such as hardware specifications, pricing models, purchase versus leasing, warranty coverage, and lifecycle strategies.
  • Develop and maintain provincial hardware standards and ensure alignment between HA requirements, OEM capabilities, Commercial teams, and suppliers.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize hardware and reduce complexity, cost, and support requirements.

Budget & Financial Management

  • Manage hardware budgets established by HA clients and monitor spending against approved forecasts and financial targets.
  • Identify, investigate, and address budget variances and unexpected procurement costs.
  • Analyze financial impacts associated with hardware decisions and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Balance inventory investment, supply chain requirements, and client demand to minimize the cost of capital while maintaining appropriate availability.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership through improved sourcing, lifecycle planning, warranty strategies, and supplier management.

Vendor & OEM Management

  • Manage strategic relationships with major PC manufacturers, OEMs, distributors, and third-party suppliers.
  • Lead regular meetings with OEMs and third-party vendors to review demand, supply, pricing, service performance, issues, and upcoming requirements.
  • Establish clear expectations for vendor performance and proactively address service, supply, pricing, and quality issues.
  • Develop and maintain supplier performance metrics and balanced scorecards in partnership with Commercial.
  • Escalate vendor issues where appropriate and drive corrective actions through to resolution.
  • Leverage supplier relationships and market knowledge to identify opportunities for improved pricing, service levels, supply continuity, and operational efficiency.

Client & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead weekly meetings with HA clients and cross-functional teams to review hardware demand, forecasts, procurement requirements, and upcoming lifecycle activities.
  • Work closely with client stakeholders to understand changing business requirements and translate them into actionable procurement and hardware strategies.
  • Present recommendations, financial impacts, risks, and trade-offs to senior stakeholders.
  • Build strong relationships with client teams and effectively manage challenging situations, competing priorities, and conflict resolution.
  • Act as a key point of contact between clients, Procurement, Commercial, OEMs, vendors, and operational teams.

Operational Improvement & Service Optimization

  • Meet regularly with frontline service and support teams to identify recurring hardware issues, operational challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Analyze ServiceNow incident and service data to identify trends and problem hardware and develop proactive strategies to reduce end-user and HA impact.
  • Evaluate warranty programs, parts availability, parts lockers, break/fix models, and other support strategies to improve service quality and optimize costs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sourcing processes, procurement tools, reporting, operational efficiency, and cost savings.
  • Develop proactive strategies for managing hardware supply, product discontinuations, quality issues, and other potential impacts to end users.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the hardware procurement and lifecycle management process.

Reporting & Governance

  • Develop and maintain balanced scorecards, procurement dashboards, forecasts, and management reporting in partnership with Commercial.
  • Provide regular reporting on hardware demand, procurement activity, supplier performance, budgets, inventory, lifecycle milestones, and risks.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting to support client and internal decision-making.
  • Maintain appropriate procurement documentation, records, and governance controls.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • 8–12 years of progressive procurement, sourcing, vendor management, or supply chain experience, preferably within B2B indirect procurement.
  • Strong experience managing procurement operations, suppliers, and vendors within an enterprise or managed services environment.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba and ServiceNow.
  • Experience managing hardware procurement and lifecycle activities, preferably within an enterprise IT or end-user computing environment.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience managing challenging client situations, negotiations, escalations, and conflict resolution.
  • Experience leading and coordinating matrixed or geographically distributed teams, including overseas resources.
  • Strong experience with PC hardware manufacturers and suppliers such as Dell, HP, Lenovo, and global resellers/distributors is preferred.
  • Direct, client-facing experience is strongly preferred.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic sourcing and procurement expertise.
  • Excellent vendor and supplier relationship management skills.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong client relationship and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence teams without direct authority.
  • Proactive approach to identifying risks, opportunities, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to balance cost, quality, service, availability, and client requirements when making procurement decisions.

As an ABM Strategist, you will support the Director of Account Based Marketing in building, running, and optimizing account-based programs across Power Digital's B2B portfolio. You are the person in the platforms daily — building account lists, monitoring intent signals, and keeping campaigns and reporting accurate so the Director can focus on strategy and client relationships.

You will work hands-on in tools like 6Sense and Demandbase to maintain target account lists, segment and score accounts, and surface intent signals that inform what Paid Media, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams do next. This role is equal parts platform execution and strategic thinking — you're expected to not just pull the data, but understand what it means and flag it before someone else has to ask.

You'll partner closely with the Director of ABM on playbook development and client-facing materials, and coordinate directly with channel teams to make sure account tiering and intent data are actually driving campaign decisions, not just sitting in a dashboard.

  • Build, maintain, and continuously refine target account lists, tiering, and scoring models in 6Sense and Demandbase
  • Monitor intent data and account engagement signals daily; flag movement and surface insights to the Director of ABM before they become client questions
  • Support the Director of ABM in developing ABM audits, playbooks, and GTM plans for clients
  • Translate account tiers and intent signals into campaign briefs and targeting inputs for Paid Media, Paid Social, Content, and Email/Lifecycle teams
  • Coordinate with channel teams to confirm account-based campaigns are executing against the intended tiering and messaging strategy
  • Own ABM reporting and dashboards; track pipeline influenced/sourced, account engagement, and movement through funnel stages
  • Support cross-agency collaboration across SEO, Paid Media, Creative, PR, Influencer, and CRO to keep ABM campaigns unified
  • Assist Revenue and Appraisal teams with account and market research for new and expanded business opportunities
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize ABM processes and reporting
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's nova ecosystem as it relates to ABM strategy and reporting
  • Join client calls and discovery discussions to represent ABM performance and platform data; build toward leading these independently

  • 2–4 years in B2B marketing, marketing operations, or ABM, in-house or in-agency

  • Working knowledge of intent data, predictive scoring, and account tiering, with a desire to go deeper on the strategy behind them
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable pulling and interpreting data without hand-holding
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to translate platform data into a takeaway a channel lead or client can act on
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage account data and reporting across multiple clients concurrently
  • Team-oriented and collaborative, with the confidence to flag issues or opportunities to more senior stakeholders
  • Agency experience valued but not required
