ABOUT NYMBUS:

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Nymbus, the AI Technical Product Manager, Core is the primary builder in our squad triad model.

You are responsible for transforming product vision into reality. Working within a dedicated squad alongside an Architect (who owns system design and technical integrity) and a Shipper (who owns delivery, quality, and release), you own the build, from specification through implementation. You operate with an AI-first, spec-first mindset, leveraging tools like Kiro and Claude to accelerate every phase of product creation.

This is not a traditional product owner or product management role. You bring your own experience, research, and creativity to design products end-to-end, authoring specifications, shaping system behavior, and iterating rapidly using AI-assisted workflows. You own the "what" and the "how," translating domain problems into working, shippable software.

THE SQUAD TRIAD MODEL:

You operate as one-third of a high-autonomy squad:

  • Technical Product Manager / Builder (This Role): Owns product intent, specification, and implementation. You are the primary creator — designing system behavior, authoring specs, and iterating with AI tools to produce working software. Deep domain knowledge is a plus; the ability to acquire it quickly is a must.
  • Architect (Your Partner): Owns system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency. The Architect ensures your solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform architecture. You collaborate daily on data models, API contracts, and integration patterns.
  • Shipper (Your Partner): Owns delivery, quality assurance, release management, and operational readiness. The Shipper ensures what you build meets quality standards, passes validation, and reaches production reliably. You collaborate on acceptance criteria, test coverage, and deployment strategy.

Together, the triad owns outcomes end-to-end — from problem definition through production operation.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN:

Product Design and Specification

  • Use AI tools (Kiro, Claude) to rapidly iterate on designs, edge cases, and alternative approaches
  • Own end-to-end product design from problem definition through system behavior and user experience
  • Author clear, testable, implementation-ready specifications using AI-assisted workflows
  • Define APIs, data models, and interaction patterns in partnership with the squad Architect
  • Translate business requirements and domain knowledge into buildable system specifications

AI-First Building and Implementation

  • Build working software using AI-assisted development workflows as the primary creation method
  • Generate, refine, and implement product and technical specifications using spec-driven development
  • Prototype and validate solutions rapidly before committing to full implementation
  • Push through ambiguity — when requirements are unclear, explore, propose, and build to learn
  • Leverage AI tools as co-developers, not just assistants, to multiply output and quality

Squad Collaboration

  • Partner daily with the Architect on API design, data modeling, and system architecture decisions
  • Coordinate with the Shipper on acceptance criteria, testability, and release readiness
  • Participate directly in technical design discussions and tradeoff decisions with the full triad
  • Surface blockers, risks, and dependencies to the squad early and proactively
  • Maintain shared context with squad partners through specifications, documentation, and working demos

WHAT YOU WILL BRING:

Product & Fintech Experience:

  • 5 plus years in product and/or engineering roles within fintech, banking, or financial services
  • Experience working with core banking platforms
  • Strong understanding of complex, regulated environments and financial workflows
  • Proven ability to translate customer and market feedback into measurable outcomes, including direct input from banks, credit unions, and their customers alongside market and competitive signals to iteratively refine features, driving improvements in customer experience, adoption, and institutional growth
  • Ability to connect business goals to technical capabilities and constraints, quickly distinguishing high-impact investments from low-value efforts to keep the work focused on what actually moves the business forward
  • Proven ability to design and build systems and workflows, not just define requirements
  • Track record of shipping working software, not just producing documentation

Technical Fluency:

  • Strong hands-on development capability across front-end and/or back-end technologies
  • Ability to own implementation end-to-end within a product domain
  • Comfort working across the stack as needed to deliver complete features
  • Plus - Understanding of REST APIs, data modeling, and system interactions
  • Plus - Familiarity with, Prisma, Redis, Kafka/SQS, AWS deployment

AI-First Mindset:

  • Active, hands-on experience with AI-assisted development workflows
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools for specification, code generation, and iteration
  • Willingness to experiment with tools and continuously improve AI-augmented building practices
  • Comfort operating in a spec-first, AI-first development methodology

Ways of working:

  • High Agency: Takes ownership of outcomes and drives work forward without waiting for permission or heavy process. Identifies what should be built and builds it.
  • Problem Solver: Thrives in ambiguity. Frames problems clearly, explores solution spaces, and converges on practical approaches quickly.
  • Builder Mindset: Measures success by what ships. Prefers building and iterating over planning and discussing. Gets energy from creating working software.
  • Experimenter: Tests ideas quickly using AI tools and iterates based on results. Explores multiple approaches before committing.
  • Quality Driven: Focuses on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability. Treats specifications and code as durable assets.
  • Scale Oriented: Designs with performance, extensibility, and operational realities in mind from the start.
  • Ownership: Takes pride in end-to-end delivery. Does not hand off and walk away — stays accountable through production. Manages other duties as assigned.

THIS ROLE ISN'T FOR:

  • Backlog administrators who manage tickets but do not build
  • Requirements writers who stay removed from how solutions get implemented
  • Developers who wait for fully specified work before starting
  • Individuals uncomfortable with ambiguity, cross-functional ownership, or AI-first workflows
  • Narrowly-scoped specialists who prefer staying in a single function

HOW WE WORK:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. Team members are expected to manage their priorities independently, communicate proactively, remain responsive, and participate on camera during virtual meetings.

A strong remote culture requires intentional effort from everyone. We expect team members to engage in our global community, proactively build relationships, participate actively in team and company conversations, seek opportunities to collaborate, and take shared ownership of creating a connected and inclusive remote community including showing up on camera.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS

As an AI-first company, we embrace the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools available to us today, including AI-enabled video interview tools, we remain equally committed to maintaining human involvement and oversight throughout the hiring process.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the position is based. This role is currently based in the United States. Not all locations are available for consideration, and locations will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, skills, and location.

By submitting this application, (i) you represent and warrant that you are not subject to or (ii) will disclose any non-compete agreement, restrictive covenant, or confidentiality obligation with a current or former employer that would restrict or prohibit you from performing the duties of the role for which you are applying.

Clinical Trial Manager with project management experience - Sponsor dedicated - Mexico

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Consultant, Platform Engineering
jobs.excerpt: AHEAD builds platforms for digital business.  By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.
AHEAD helps large enterprises assess, design, build, and migrate to Amazon Web Services (AWS), and increasingly helps those same enterprises design, build, and run AI agent platforms on top of it. This role sits in the AIC Platform Engineering practice, alongside consultants who lead AWS assessments, landing zone build-outs, and cloud migrations, and specializes that practice's AWS depth toward AI agent platforms. As a Principal Technical Consultant, you own that work end to end at client sites: you assess current state, design the target platform, build it, wire up the delivery pipeline, and leave the client team able to run it without you.

This is a hands-on role with delivery leadership attached. You will write infrastructure code, agent code, and the documents that client governance boards approve, and you will lead the junior and mid-level consultants delivering alongside you. You will present your own work to engineering leaders and executives, and you will teach client makers, developers, and platform teams how to build on what you delivered. Our clients include firms in regulated and confidentiality-driven industries, so the platforms you build are private-networked, policy-governed, and evaluated before anything reaches production.

What you will do

    Consulting and delivery leadership

    • Work directly with client stakeholders to interpret business and operational challenges and translate them into the right technical solution, whether that is an AWS landing zone, a migration wave, or an agentic platform: which platform fits, what data and governance boundaries apply, and what the first production candidate should be.

    • Lead junior and mid-level consultants on your engagements: set technical direction, review their work, unblock them daily, and develop them into independent delivery owners.

    • Shape engagements alongside AHEAD account teams: scope workstreams, define deliverables, estimate effort, and keep delivery on plan as client priorities shift.

    • Build and maintain strong client relationships beyond the current statement of work, and identify opportunities to expand AHEAD's footprint through upsell and cross-sell.

    • Serve as the senior technical voice in client steering and working sessions, presenting options with tradeoffs and a clear recommendation rather than a menu.

    AWS platform engineering

    • Lead AWS discovery and assessment engagements: current-state architecture reviews, workload and application inventories with AWS Application Discovery Service, dependency mapping, and cloud readiness assessments that inform landing zone and migration roadmaps.

    • Design and deploy enterprise-scale AWS landing zones using AWS Control Tower and Landing Zone Accelerator: multi-account structures under AWS Organizations, service control policies, centralized logging, and IAM Identity Center foundations.

    • Plan and execute migrations to AWS: workload assessment and wave planning with AWS Migration Hub, application migration with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and Database Migration Service (DMS), cutover runbooks, and post-migration validation across compute, storage, databases, and containers.

    • Establish hybrid and cross-premises connectivity: AWS Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, and Route 53 Resolver strategies that connect client on-premises environments to AWS.

    • Own cost governance and FinOps practices: AWS Budgets and Cost Anomaly Detection, tagging standards, Savings Plans and Reserved Instance strategy, and showback or chargeback reporting through Cost Explorer.

    AI agent platform engineering and delivery

    • Design and deploy Amazon Bedrock environments for enterprise clients, including network-isolated configurations behind client firewalls: VPC endpoints, AWS PrivateLink, IAM role and resource policy design, and KMS customer-managed keys.

    • Stand up Bedrock AgentCore and Bedrock Agents governance for client accounts: guardrails, model access policies, knowledge base and connector governance, and licensing and capacity guidance.

    • Build promotion pipelines in GitHub Actions that move agents from sandbox to production through automated tests, evaluation thresholds, and human approval gates implemented as environment protection rules.

    • Implement evaluation and safety frameworks: golden datasets, quality, retrieval, and safety evaluators run in CI, Bedrock Guardrails, and compensating controls for model paths where platform content filtering does not apply.

    • Develop agents in code with Bedrock AgentCore and bring-your-own-framework options such as Strands or LangGraph, and establish ALM so agents move between environments by pipeline rather than by hand.

    • Advise clients on model selection and placement across the Bedrock model catalog, including Anthropic and Amazon Nova models, with data residency, in-region inference, and cost as first-class constraints.

    Documentation and enablement

    • Author the design documents, as-builts, build guides, technical roadmaps, and runbooks the client operates from after the engagement ends.

    • Run workshops, enablement sessions, and office hours for client makers, developers, and administrators.

    • Prepare review packages and evidence for client AI governance boards, and keep decision registers current during delivery.

What you bring

    • 8+ years in engineering or technical consulting, including 5+ years delivering AWS infrastructure, landing zones, or migrations, and at least 18 months delivering GenAI or agent systems to production.

    • Delivery leadership. You have led small consulting or engineering teams on client work: assigning and reviewing work, mentoring junior consultants, and staying accountable for the engagement outcome, not just your own tasks.

    • Solution framing. You can take an ambiguous client problem and land it as a concrete architecture, whether that is an AWS landing zone, a migration plan, or an agentic system: pattern, platform choice, data boundaries, and the governance path to production. You know when the right answer is not an agent, and when it is not a rebuild.

    • AWS landing zone and migration depth. Hands-on delivery of Control Tower and Landing Zone Accelerator environments, Migration Hub and MGN-based discovery and migration, multi-account network design with Transit Gateway, and workload right-sizing at enterprise scale.

    • AWS platform core services. Hands-on design and implementation across compute (EC2, ECS, EKS), storage (S3, EBS, EFS), networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink), databases (RDS, DynamoDB), containers, IAM, and security (KMS, Security Hub, GuardDuty). You can explain what must exist before a network-injected AWS service can be created and what cannot be changed afterward.

    • Amazon Bedrock, hands-on. The AgentCore runtime, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, model catalog management, and OpenSearch Serverless for retrieval in isolated environments.

    • Agent frameworks, hands-on. Building agents with Bedrock Agents or bring-your-own-framework tooling such as Strands or LangGraph, IAM-based agent identity, and CI/CD-driven ALM.

    • IaC and CI/CD ownership. Infrastructure as code with Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK, and GitHub Actions workflows with environments, protection rules, and OIDC federation to AWS. Pipelines and landing zones you built, not ones you used.

    • Evaluation-driven delivery. You promote agents on evaluation results against a baseline, not on demos, and you can design the dataset and thresholds that make that possible.

    • Consulting-grade communication. Design documents and technical roadmaps other people can execute, and the ability to explain and defend technical decisions with client executives, security teams, and governance boards.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

Storyblok is hiring a Marketing Automation Manager to own the top of funnel systems and the campaigns that run through them: Pardot, the forms on the Storyblok website, list uploads, Clay, and the nurture programs, sequences and webinar flows built in Pardot. The role sends the campaigns, loads the lists and builds the forms day to day, and turns that repeat work into templates and automations so more of the week goes to lead scoring, routing, data quality and reporting. Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Demand Generation, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Operations and Analytics, in a lean data team where the person pulls their own numbers and builds their own reports.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  1. Campaign operations
  • Build and send list emails and sequences in Pardot and Knak: webinar invites and follow ups, quarterly enterprise and marketer sequences, review asks, partner and event emails.
  • Build and run the nurture programs in Engagement Studio (welcome, post webinar, gated content, re-engagement), each by segment and lifecycle stage, and rebuild them as results come in.
  • Set up webinars end to end: registration form, Zuddl to Pardot sync, campaign IDs, reminders and follow up. Build form handlers, autoresponders and landing page forms on the Storyblok website.
  • Load lead lists from events, content syndication and paid social with the right campaign, source and consent, and run the request board: intake, SLA, QA before launch.
  • Run optimization: Test subject lines, send times and content on every sequence, and personalise by segment, industry and stage.
  1. Marketing systems and integrations
  • Administer Pardot and its Salesforce sync: users, connectors, field mapping, campaign member status.
  • Own the links between Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Zuddl, Knak, Meta and Google Ads, and keep them documented.
  • Run Clay: enrichment waterfalls, list building, and the signal tables that feed BDR routing.
  • Evaluate, buy and renew the marketing tools.
  1. Lead flow, scoring and routing operations
  • Own lead scoring and grading, reviewed each quarter against what converts.
  • Own lifecycle stages (MQL, SAL, SQL) and the handoff rules to BDRs and AEs.
  • Bring self serve signups and product usage into scoring and lifecycle, so PLG and enterprise leads run through 1 flow.
  1. Data quality and reporting
  • Own the sync between the warehouse, Pardot and Salesforce in both directions: enrichment and usage in, campaign results out.
  • Keep the database clean: dedupe, normalise country, industry and title, suppression lists, GDPR consent by region.
  • Own the campaign taxonomy and UTM standard across the team and agencies.
  • Write your own SQL and Salesforce reports; build the funnel and pipeline by source reports in the BI tool. Watch deliverability: domain health, bounce and spam rates.
  1. Automation, process and cadence
  • Template the repeat request types (list uploads, list emails, form handlers, webinar setups), then automate them with Clay, LLM tools (Claude) and a workflow builder such as n8n or Zapier, each with QA and a fallback.
  • Write the playbooks and train marketers to self serve where it is safe.
  • Own and report monthly on speed to lead, MQL to SQL and form to meeting rates, request turnaround and share automated, database coverage and accuracy, and email deliverability and engagement.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years in marketing operations or marketing automation, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Pardot administration: Salesforce connector, Engagement Studio, form handlers, campaign sync. Salesforce fluency: campaigns, lead and contact fields, reports and dashboards.
  • Built nurture programs and can show what they did to conversion.
  • Ran a request queue at volume and cut the time per request with templates and automation; shipped automations with a workflow builder and LLM tools and kept them running.
  • Lead scoring, lifecycle and routing experience, with results.
  • Working SQL, and hands on with an enrichment tool such as Clay, ZoomInfo or Apollo.
  • Knowledge of GDPR and consent management across regions.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES

  • Operating discipline: runs a high volume request queue on an SLA with QA before every launch.
  • Systems thinking: sees how Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Clay and the warehouse connect, and keeps the data flowing cleanly between them.
  • Data fluency: pulls own numbers, defines fields and builds reports without an analyst in between.
  • Automation mindset: templates repeat work, then builds the automation that removes it.
  • Attention to detail: a wrong list or a broken form reaches thousands of people.
  • Testing habit: runs tests on every sequence and changes the program based on results.
  • Cross-functional coordination: aligns Demand Gen, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development and Sales Ops around 1 lead flow.
  • Communication: writes clear playbooks and guidance that marketers follow without a meeting.

jobs.description:
EventMobi is remote-first. This role is open to candidates residing in Canada. Expect to be on the road about once a month for events across the US, Canada and Europe. This is a player-coach role.

Know Someone Perfect for This Role? We offer a referral fee of $2,500 CAD (Internal Only).

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

You are at the top of your ‘event’ game and excited by the idea of marketing events and event tech to the people who run them. And even more excited to grow EventMobi’s event team and our portfolio of events.

Our customers are experienced conference organizers. So is the crowd at every show we exhibit at. You'll walk the floor knowing your audience better than anyone in the building, because you are your audience. Our marketing ethos is to offer value at every interaction, and in-person events are the best way to educate and engage the events community and our customer base.

You'll own EventMobi's entire events program: the trade shows, the sponsorships, and the events we host ourselves. Strategy, budget, messaging, booth, results. Start with local workshops and exclusive dinners, build momentum, and turn it into our first user conference. Not many people get to say they launched one of those.

EventMobi is a one-of-a-kind bootstrapped gem, built on people who show up for each other. Founded in 2010, and growing sustainably. No VC money shenanigans or crazy expectations. Every dollar you put into an event has a job to do, and you'll know exactly what it earned.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You're a marketer first. Events are your channel, and pipeline is your scoreboard. Your secret weapon is superb organization and project management.
  • You know your events cost per opportunity before anyone asks. And you'd rather cut a beloved event than defend one that doesn't pay off.

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON

1. Own the Tradeshow Floor

For every show, you own the whole story: the calendar, budget, messaging, the pre-show marketing push, booth design, shipping, staffing and on-site execution. You make sure potential buyers know where to find us, work with Demand Gen and Sales to fill the calendar with meetings before the doors open, and ensure every lead lands in HubSpot, attributed. On the floor, you're the event tech expert in the room. You know what competitors are up to, how EventMobi stacks up, and you design the activation to create the differentiation.

2. Make Every Sponsored Event Pay Off

When we sponsor an industry event with our event tech, your team is the single point of contact. You lock the give/get in writing early, run our on-site presence, and grow our database with every opt-in. You partner with Customer Success so their event is a hit, spot the features they should be using next, and hand advocacy wins like case studies and reviews to Customer Marketing.

3. Build EventMobi’s Owned Events, From Local Dinners to Our First User Conference
You decide what every event we host is for: new pipeline or deeper customer relationships. Then you build it: format, agenda, speakers, venue, run of show, and the marketing that fills the room. Everything runs on EventMobi, because our own events are the best demo we've got. You'll start with local workshops and meetups and grow them into our annual user conference.

4. Run It Like Your Business

You keep the single source of truth for every event, project manage each one, own vendors and contracts, and forecast the budget so there are no surprises. Every quarter, you bring the VP of Marketing a clear call on what to scale, what to maintain and what to cut, backed by spend, pipeline and revenue.

SUPPORT & COLLABORATION

You can’t do this alone. Here's who's in it with you:

  • Event Coordinator: reports to you, full-time from day one. As the program grows, so does the team.
  • VP of Marketing: your manager and biggest support. Direction, prioritization, and the person who clears blockers.
  • Demand Gen: deploys your campaigns and partners with you on target accounts and meeting bookings.
  • Sales: your crew on the floor, and the people who turn booth conversations into revenue. Most are pros at this, but there are always our noobs who will love your help and guidance to show up strong.
  • Customer Success: Supports the build and management of event tech for the sponsored industry conferences.
  • Marketing Operations: HubSpot, attribution and reporting, so your numbers hold up in any room.
  • Tools: HubSpot, Claude, Zapier, Notion, Fellow, Slack, Google Workspace, and of course, the EventMobi platform itself.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in corporate event marketing at a B2B company. You've been the exhibitor in the booth, not just the agency or the organizer running the show.
  • You've managed a high volume of third-party trade shows and sponsored events portfolio
  • You have been involved in the planning and execution of a mid-size user conference and exclusive dinner series.
  • Strong Event Tech experience. Registration platforms, lead capture apps, badge printing and event app builds using EventMobi’s competitors.
  • Bonus points if you already know this industry from the inside. IMEX, MPI, PCMA, CSAE, ASAE are familiar acronyms to you.
  • You've owned an event budget and can show what each event returned in pipeline and revenue. Not just badge scans.
  • You write sharp event messaging and copy yourself, and you're proud of it.
  • You treat HubSpot and attribution as part of the job, demand gen is there for support but you know where your event leads are at.
  • You're up for travelling about once a month across North America and Europe

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Compensation: $120-$140K CAD (Base + Bonus), Stock Option, and Benefits
  • Time-Off: 15 days annual leave + 3 summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun)
  • Regional in-person gatherings and co-working sessions to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Tools: Top-of-the-line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work, so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone who has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30 Mbps download speed.
  • You are a Canadian Citizen or Permanent Resident eligible to work and travel to the US, Canada and Europe.

MORE ABOUT EVENTMOBI

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 40,000 events in 70+ countries, from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, American Political Science Association, GE, Best Buy, Ontario Nursing Association have all trusted EventMobi's suite of software to manage their internal and public conferences and engage their attendees, speakers and sponsors.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.title: Senior Data Migration Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Who we areAt WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling, patient care.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At WELLSTAR, we are committed to reshaping Canadian healthcare by leveraging technology to address the administrative burdens that pull physicians away from their true calling, patient care. Our mission is to support providers and patients, shifting the emphasis back to quality, timeliness, and positive outcomes. With a comprehensive suite of technology solutions, we have successfully helped thousands of providers adopt and benefit from modern, interoperable technologies that improve patient outcomes and system efficiency.

Whether you are in research and development, administration, communications, operations leadership, or technology, joining us now is an opportunity to play a critical role in transforming how healthcare is managed and experienced in Canada.

WELLSTAR Clinical Platform Group brings together the EMR technology that supports clinics and healthcare providers across Canada, including OSCAR Pro, Juno, HealthQuest, and Cerebrum. As part of the broader WELL Health ecosystem, we are focused on helping providers adopt modern, scalable, and connected technology that supports better care delivery and reduces administrative complexity.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Director of Implementations, we are hiring a Senior Data Migration Specialist to join our Implementations team. As our new Senior Data Migration Specialist, you will be the senior technical resource for EMR data migrations, helping clinics and healthcare organizations move from legacy systems to WELLSTAR platforms accurately, securely, and with minimal disruption.

You will support high-profile enterprise migrations across OSCAR Pro and Juno to start, with broader exposure across WELLSTAR’s clinical platform group as the organization continues to grow. You will work across test migrations, data validation, final migrations, issue resolution, and go-live readiness, partnering with implementation team members, vendors, clinic administrators, physicians, and technical customer contacts.

This is a full-time remote role open to candidates across Canada. Flexibility is required to support migration windows that may occasionally fall outside standard business hours, including early Eastern or later Pacific time, to minimize disruption to clinics during operating hours.

What is in it for you

Influence. You will shape a high-impact function at a pivotal time. WELLSTAR is operating at a pivotal moment in Canadian healthcare technology, with increasing demand for secure, scalable, connected clinical platforms. This is an opportunity to directly influence migration speed, data accuracy, customer readiness, and go-live success. By improving how data is mapped, validated, migrated, and supported, you will reduce rework, lower risk, and help clinics maintain access to the historical information they rely on to deliver care.

Impact. You will create leverage through better tools and processes. You will improve the scripts, tools, workflows, and repeatable approaches that support migration work. Your contributions will help the team move faster, work more consistently, and scale migration volume without compromising quality or privacy. This is a chance to apply deep technical expertise to work that matters: making healthcare technology easier to adopt, trust, and use.

A meaningful mission. WELLSTAR is part of a healthcare technology ecosystem serving a significant portion of practitioners across Canada. You will join a specialized team focused on solving practical, high-value problems in healthcare technology, where your expertise will be visible and valued. As migration needs evolve, you will have the opportunity to mentor others, strengthen team practices, and contribute to the future structure of the migration function.

How you will make an impact:

  • Help set the technical direction for complex migrations. You will lead complex, high-value EMR conversions for multi-location practices and enterprise healthcare organizations. You will identify risks early, guide data strategy, and serve as the escalation point when migration complexity threatens timelines, accuracy, or go-live readiness.
  • Create more scalable migration infrastructure. You will help design and maintain the scripts, tools, reusable approaches, and validation standards that support WELLSTAR’s conversion work. You will focus on the big picture, building repeatable approaches that reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and increase confidence across every stage of the migration lifecycle.
  • Influence product and implementation outcomes. You will bring the voice of Implementation into Product and Engineering conversations, advocating for import capabilities, integrations, and platform improvements that reduce friction for customers and internal teams. Your insight into the complexity of real-world healthcare data will help shape decisions that improve implementation quality and platform scalability.
  • Raise the bar for migration quality and governance. You will evolve the team’s migration playbook, including mapping standards, validation methods, cutover planning, documentation, and compliance-conscious data handling. You will ensure tools and processes support secure, accurate, and auditable migration work aligned with PHI, HIPAA, SOC 2, and internal expectations.
  • Develop capability across the team. You will mentor junior and mid-level specialists, support stronger technical practices, and help build a shared standard for how migration work is scoped, delivered, reviewed, and improved. As the function grows, you will help shape the team’s capacity, operating model, and future leadership structure.
  • Measure and improve migration performance. You will track and report on migration outcomes, including data accuracy, timeline adherence, rework, automation gains, and delivery risk. You will use those insights to improve processes, strengthen planning, and help implementation leadership make informed decisions about priorities and capacity.

What you bring:

  • The EMR data migration experience. You have strong experience working with EMR, EHR, practice management, healthcare data, or similar data migration environments. Direct EMR migration experience is highly preferred, especially with platforms such as TELUS Health PSS, CHR, Med Access, Avaros, Accuro, Oscar Pro, Juno, or similar Canadian EMR systems.
  • The migration mindset. You understand how data moves from one system to another, including extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, and final load processes. You can balance technical detail with customer timelines, vendor coordination, implementation delivery, and go-live readiness.
  • The technical depth. You are comfortable getting into systems, understanding back-end structures, manipulating data, and solving complex migration problems. You bring strong SQL skills and experience with scripts, tools, or technical processes that support accurate, efficient data movement.
  • The customer-facing confidence. You can communicate clearly with internal teams, vendors, clinic administrators, physicians, and technical customer stakeholders. You ask good questions, explain issues in practical terms, and help customers feel supported through complex transitions.
  • The tooling and automation capability. You have experience working with, improving, or building tools that support data migration, validation, reporting, or repeatable data processes. Experience with Python or a comparable language, Git, ETL tooling, cloud platforms, or CI/CD pipelines would be an asset.
  • The regulated data judgement. You understand the responsibility that comes with handling sensitive information in healthcare or another highly regulated industry. You approach data access, privacy, validation, documentation, and secure handling with care and sound judgement.
  • The leadership potential. You bring ownership, maturity, and a collaborative approach. You may have mentored others, supported junior team members, led project work, or acted as an escalation point, and you are interested in growing your impact as the team evolves.

Why join us?

WELLSTAR is a leading healthcare technology company dedicated to reshaping healthcare through digital enablement. We provide a comprehensive, holistic solution for healthcare providers across Canada, with over 40% of practitioners currently using our products and services. Our solutions serve primary care physicians, specialist physicians, health systems, and public sector organizations through a complete suite of solutions, including billing and practice management systems, electronic medical records (EMRs), digital health applications, and digital health network solutions.

Description

MWDN is an international recruitment and outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience connecting exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments—no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Domain: Data Infrastructure & Analytics / AdTech

Client Location: Israel

Company size: 11–50

Founded in: 2025

A fast‑growing ad‑tech company building next‑generation programmatic advertising infrastructure. The team focuses on high‑performance systems, real‑time bidding, and AI‑driven optimization. The environment is fast, product‑focused, and highly collaborative, with strong engineering leadership and a culture of ownership.

What makes this project exciting?

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our engineering team and help shape the future of programmatic advertising. You'll architect and build high‑performance systems that process millions of ad transactions in real time, while leveraging cutting‑edge AI technologies to optimize outcomes for our partners.

This role sits at the intersection of ad‑tech and AI, working with massive‑scale systems and sub‑millisecond latency requirements. You’ll own the full development lifecycle from architecture to deployment, collaborating with a modern, high‑performing engineering team.

What makes you a great fit

  • 5+ years of professional data engineering experience
  • 2+ years working with programmatic advertising or ad-tech data
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Experience with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse)
  • Experience with batch processing frameworks (Spark, dbt, Airflow)
  • Understanding of ad-tech data structures: bid requests, impressions, OpenRTB schemas, log-level data
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code

Ad-Tech Stack:

Data Sources (Familiarity Required):

  • SSP reporting APIs and log-level data (Magnite, PubMatic, Index Exchange, Xandr)
  • Google Ad Manager (GAM) reporting, Data Transfer files, and BigQuery exports
  • Prebid Analytics adapters and bid stream data
  • Mobile measurement platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Kochava) for app monetization data
  • Real-time bidding (RTB) log files and auction data

Data Models & Metrics:

  • Revenue metrics: CPM, eCPM, RPM, fill rate, win rate, bid density
  • Auction analytics: bid landscape, floor optimization, timeout analysis
  • Demand partner performance: SSP/bidder scoring, latency analysis
  • Supply chain data: ads.txt validation, sellers.json mapping, SPO analysis

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ML feature engineering for bid optimization or yield prediction
  • Background in building data products for publisher-side monetization
  • Familiarity with privacy-preserving data techniques (differential privacy, clean rooms)
  • Experience with CTV/OTT advertising data and video ad metrics
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and cross-device data challenges

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines for processing bid stream, impression, and revenue data from programmatic sources
  • Ingest and normalize data from multiple SSPs, DSPs, ad servers (GAM), and third-party reporting APIs
  • Build real-time and batch processing systems for auction analytics, win rate analysis, and bid landscape modeling
  • Develop ETL/ELT workflows to transform raw programmatic data into analytics-read datasets
  • Create data models for yield optimization, floor price analysis, and demand partner performance
  • Build and maintain data warehouses and lakes optimized for ad-tech query patterns
  • Implement data quality monitoring, validation, and anomaly detection for programmatic data streams
  • Support BI and analytics teams with clean, documented, and performant data infrastructure
  • Ensure data privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA) in data collection, storage, and processing

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid sick days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Tech interview — ✅ Home assignment — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer

  • Win technical evaluations: Guide enterprise prospects through demanding architecture reviews, competitive bake-offs, POCs, and time-sensitive decisions with structure, urgency, and sound judgment.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Engineering Manager.

About the job

As a Senior Engineering Manager in Compliance Experiences, you will lead the Know Your Customer (KYC) engineering team as it builds out Twilio's new Compliance Domain. Your team owns Trust Hub, Twilio's KYC Platform and the gateway to accessing all of Twilio's communication APIs. It serves two distinct customer bases: external customers - Twilio's customers who depend on seamless regulatory compliance to provision and manage phone numbers globally, and internal customers - engineering teams across Twilio who rely on your team's compliance APIs, services, and Ops Tooling to operate efficiently. You will own the people strategy, delivery execution, and stakeholder relationships for a team processing millions of requests daily.

You will be expected to champion AI-driven development practices, ensuring your engineers adopt LLMs and agentic tools to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and stay at the forefront of modern software engineering. Your mission is to build a high-performing team that consistently ships reliable, customer-obsessed products - while balancing the competing demands of external product commitments, internal platform obligations, and operational tooling investments.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • DRAW THE OWL: Own the delivery roadmap for the Compliance Domain, including customer-facing compliance services, internal platform APIs, and Ops Tooling. Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers to translate long-term technical strategy into executable quarterly plans and measurable outcomes.
  • ACCELERATE WITH AI: Drive the adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Anthropic Claude, or internal LLMs) within your team. Set expectations for AI-augmented workflows, measure the impact on team velocity, and create the psychological safety for engineers to experiment with new tools.
  • BE AN OWNER: Take full accountability for your team’s operational excellence, including system reliability, incident response, on-call health, and security posture. Make high-judgment calls that balance speed, quality, and risk.
  • WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Serve two customer bases with equal rigor. For external customers, partner with Product Management to ensure compliance workflows are seamless and developer-friendly. For internal customers, proactively engage with dependent engineering teams to understand their needs, gather feedback on your team’s APIs and Ops Tooling, and ensure your platform enables them to move faster. Ground every decision in customer data and feedback from both audiences.
  • EMPOWER OTHERS: Recruit, develop, and retain a world-class engineering team. Build a culture of psychological safety, candid feedback, and career growth. Coach your engineers-from mid-level to staff-to reach their full potential and take on increasing ownership. Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion in every hiring and development decision.
  • RUTHLESSLY PRIORITIZE: Navigate competing priorities across external product features, internal platform needs, and Ops Tooling investments. Balance requests from multiple stakeholders-Product Management, internal engineering teams, and operations-with a clear framework for saying “no” to protect focus. Ensure resources are aligned to the highest-impact work across all three pillars.
  • WRITE IT DOWN: Communicate team strategy, progress, and risks clearly and consistently to engineering leadership and cross-functional partners. Author team plans, post-mortems, and decision documents that create transparency and alignment.
  • BUILD BRIDGES: Act as the primary point of contact between the Compliance Domain and its stakeholders. Manage relationships with Product Management, external-facing teams, and internal engineering teams that depend on your compliance services and Ops Tooling. Proactively communicate roadmap plans, surface trade-offs, negotiate priorities, and ensure stakeholders have clear visibility into what your team is delivering and why.
  • NO SHENANIGANS: Model integrity in every interaction. Create an environment where engineers feel safe raising concerns, surfacing problems early, and challenging the status quo. Hold yourself and your team to the highest standards of ethical behavior.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience with at least 5+ years in engineering management, leading a team of 10+ engineers and directly managing individual contributors.
  • Technical Depth: Strong hands-on background in designing and operating highly available, cloud-native distributed systems. You don’t need to write code daily, but you must be able to engage deeply in architectural reviews, evaluate technical proposals, and earn the trust of your senior engineers.
  • Cloud-Native Fluency: Deep familiarity with AWS ecosystems (Lambda, EKS, DynamoDB, Kafka), microservices patterns, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Kubernetes, Terraform).
  • AI-Forward Mindset: Demonstrated experience driving AI tool adoption within your engineering team. You should be able to articulate a clear vision for how AI accelerates your team’s delivery and quality.
  • Delivery Excellence: Proven track record of shipping complex software products on time and at high quality. Experience with agile methodologies and a data-driven approach to measuring team health and productivity.
  • People Leadership: A track record of building diverse, inclusive, high-performing engineering teams. Experience with career frameworks, performance management, and growing engineers from mid-level to staff-plus.
  • Clear Communication: Strong ability to communicate technical strategy, trade-offs, and team plans to engineering leadership, cross-functional partners, and your direct reports.
  • Stakeholder Management: Proven ability to manage relationships across multiple stakeholder groups with competing needs. Experience balancing external customer commitments with internal platform obligations and communicating trade-offs transparently.
  • Operational Rigor: Experience owning system reliability for mission-critical services, including incident management, on-call rotations, and SLO-driven operational improvements.

Desired:

  • Platform & Tooling Leadership: Experience leading a team that builds internal platforms or operational tooling serving other engineering teams, with a product mindset toward internal customers.
  • Team Scaling: Experience growing and evolving a team through periods of change, including onboarding new engineers, reshaping team processes, and managing through ambiguity.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India - Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana State, Maharashtra and New Delhi.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. jobs.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

About Clariti

Clariti builds community development software for cities and counties: permitting, licensing, plan review, and the workflows that let local governments serve their residents. We are in the middle of an AI-native transformation: AI is becoming part of our products and part of how our engineering pods build them.

About the role

Clariti's products run the permitting and community development operations of cities across North America. We are rethinking how that software should work when AI is part of the product and part of how the product gets built, and the engineering pod you would join is at the center of that work.

You will join a product engineering pod as a developer. The pod is small and senior, and works inside our Agentic SDLC framework: agent specs, orchestration workflows, reusable prompts, and eval harnesses that let a handful of engineers deliver at multiples of traditional velocity. You will not be typing every line yourself. You will be directing, reviewing, and shaping the work of coding agents, then owning the result as if you had written it, because you are accountable for it either way.

This is a product engineering role. Your job is to ship products: features cities will use to issue permits, run inspections, and serve residents, delivered to the quality bar government software demands.

What you will do

  • Ship product. Take features from spec through delivery in production, working within the pod's agentic workflow. Own the outcome end to end: correctness, performance, security, and the experience of the person at the counter who has to use it.
  • Work agent-first. Write clear specs and acceptance criteria, direct coding agents to implement them, review the output critically, and iterate. Your leverage is judgment, not keystrokes.
  • Hold the quality bar. Government software is scrutinized differently than consumer software. You test what agents produce, you understand what you ship, and you do not merge what you cannot explain.
  • Improve how the pod works. Feed what you learn about the framework, the workflows, and the agents back to the pod and to the Applied AI team that owns the framework. Velocity is a shared asset; you help keep it high.
  • Learn the domain. Permitting, licensing, plan review, inspections, and the rules cities live under. The best engineers here understand why a workflow exists before they change it.

What you bring

  • 7+ years as a software developer shipping production web applications, with deep fundamentals in API design, data modeling, testing, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Real experience building with coding agents and AI-assisted development tools, and a clear-eyed view of what they are good at and where they fail. You have shipped production code this way, not just experimented.
  • Strong written communication. In an agent-first pod, the quality of your specs determines the quality of the code.
  • The habit of reading and understanding what you ship, including code you did not type. You verify; you do not assume.
  • Comfort with pace and ambiguity. The roadmap is ambitious and the pod moves quickly.

Nice to have

  • Experience in government, civic, or other regulated software, where auditability and accessibility are requirements rather than preferences.
  • Experience with permitting, land management, or community development systems, or with the operations of a municipal government.
  • Experience with eval-driven development or building evaluation harnesses for AI-generated code.

How success is measured

  • 90 days: you understand the codebase, the pod's agentic workflow, and the permitting domain well enough to take features from spec to production without close supervision, at the pod's quality bar and without slowing the team down. You are shipping at the pod's average throughput: not a first feature or two, but a steady stream of production features every week, at the same pace and quality as the developers who were here before you.
  • 12 months: you are a dependable owner of meaningful parts of the product, trusted to take ambiguous problems from a customer conversation through to a shipped, well-tested feature. Your specs and reviews raise the quality of the pod's output, and you have made at least one lasting improvement to how the pod works, not just what it ships.

What’s in it for you?🫵

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $103,000- $160,000 based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

ABOUT THE ROLE

RootstockLabs is seeking a visionary Fund Manager to architect, launch, and scale an institutional-grade, BTC-denominated investment fund from the ground up. This fund will enable institutional and private Bitcoin holders to unlock yield and manage credit risk through a mixed portfolio of strategies.

By bridging traditional institutional demand and Bitcoin-native yield generation, the fund serves as a trusted, regulated vehicle for deploying sophisticated capital.

As a founding leader, you will own the fund's strategy, portfolio construction, risk management framework, investor relations, and regulatory governance. This is a high-impact, greenfield opportunity to define a flagship financial product in the Bitcoin ecosystem.

The mandate

  • Objective: Deliver risk-adjusted returns measured in BTC, with principal preservation in BTC terms as the first priority.
  • Vehicle: Cayman Islands SPC, CIMA-registered, with independent directors and a third-party administrator, auditor and custodian.
  • Investors: L1 foundations and treasuries, ecosystem funds and selected institutional allocators seeking BTC exposure with yield.
  • Strategies: BTC-collateralised lending, market-neutral and basis strategies, liquidity provision, and yield on Rootstock and other Bitcoin-aligned venues, within board-approved limits. Directional exposure and unhedged leverage are out of scope unless the board expressly approves them.
  • Target size: $500 million committed capital within 12 months of launch.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Investment and portfolio management

  • Set the fund's investment strategy, allocation policy and limits, and take them through board approval.
  • Source, diligence and execute positions across BTC lending, basis and on-chain yield strategies.
  • Run counterparty and protocol due diligence, including smart-contract, bridge, custody and liquidation risk.
  • Report performance in BTC terms, with clear attribution by strategy.

Risk management

  • Build the risk framework: exposure limits, concentration, liquidity buckets, collateral haircuts and drawdown triggers.
  • Monitor positions daily and stress-test against BTC price shocks, venue failure and depeg events.
  • Maintain a liquidity profile that matches investor redemption terms.

Investor relations and capital raising

  • Raise capital from L1 foundations, ecosystem funds and institutional allocators, within applicable marketing and solicitation rules.
  • Structure share classes, side letters and terms suited to foundation treasuries.
  • Produce monthly investor reporting and quarterly letters; lead investor calls and annual meetings.

Governance, compliance and operations

  • Work with the board, independent directors, AML officers (AMLCO/MLRO), administrator, auditor and legal counsel.
  • Own the offering documents, valuation policy and NAV process alongside the administrator.
  • Ensure ongoing regulatory compliance, including CIMA filings, AML/KYC on investors and annual audit.
  • Select and manage service providers: custodians, prime brokers, OTC desks and on-chain infrastructure.

Team and ecosystem

  • Hire and lead a small team (analyst, risk, operations) as the fund scales.
  • Act as the fund's senior voice with L1 ecosystems, and feed investor demand back into Rootstock's product roadmap.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years in asset management, credit, or trading, with at least 5 years as a portfolio manager or CIO with P&L responsibility.
  • A track record managing a regulated fund or institutional mandate, ideally $100M+ AUM.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Bitcoin markets, BTC-collateralised lending, derivatives and basis trades.
  • Working knowledge of DeFi mechanics: lending protocols, liquidity pools, bridges and their failure modes.
  • Strong fund governance experience: offering documents, NAV and valuation, audit, and working with independent boards.
  • Existing relationships with crypto foundations, treasuries or institutional allocators, and a record of raising capital.
  • Able to meet director and key-person fitness and propriety standards in the fund's jurisdiction, with a clean regulatory history.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with Cayman fund and BVI Investment Management structure.
  • Background in structured credit (tranching, waterfalls) or treasury management.
  • Relevant qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, FRM, PRM, or an equivalent regulatory licence.
  • Familiarity with Rootstock, Bitcoin L2s or merged-mining ecosystems.

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.
  • 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days
  • Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.
  • Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

  • What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies
  • Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions
  • Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money).
  • Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand

jobs.description:
Meade is a full-service design firm specializing in innovative and cost-effective engineering solutions for data centers, cloud providers, and large-scale construction projects.
