If you're looking to be part of a company that values expertise, teamwork, and cutting-edge design, we'd love to hear from you!

***This is a physical infrastructure design role — not software or IT networking. You'll design the cabling, pathways, and telecom rooms that data centers and mission-critical buildings run on: fiber/copper backbone routing, rack elevations, conduit systems, and construction drawings in Revit. Think structured cabling and building infrastructure design, not network administration or coding.***

Job Description:

Meade is seeking an RCDD-certified ICT Infrastructure Design EngineerI (Low Voltage)to join our Engineering team. This is a specialized role focused on the design of network infrastructure and structured cabling systems for mission critical and data center projects. This position will play a key role in delivering high-quality designs for complex projects while continuing to build technical expertise in a niche, high-demand discipline.

The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in network architecture and structured cabling systems.

Job Duties:

Network Design & Architecture

  • Design ICT and network infrastructure systems, including structured cabling (fiber and copper) and telecommunications pathways.
  • Develop LAN/WAN topology diagrams, logical network layouts, and physical infrastructure design, cable routing, and pathway layouts.
  • Produce detailed deliverables including:
    • Construction drawings
    • Cable routing and pathway layouts
    • Equipment schedules and specifications
    • Telecommunications room layouts and rack elevations
  • Design passive infrastructure including fiber backbone systems, copper cabling, and cross-connect/ODF configurations.
  • Design Service Entrance Facility (SEF) infrastructure, including fiber vault placement, underground conduit stub-outs, and coordination of carrier incoming fiber pathways.
  • Develop outside plant (OSP) designs including underground conduit systems, pull boxes, handholes, and site conduit routing in coordination with civil and electrical disciplines.
  • Apply industry standards (BICSI, TIA/EIA, ANSI) to ensure compliant and scalable designs.

Adjacent Systems Integration

  • Support the design and coordination of low-voltage systems, including:
    • Audiovisual (AV) systems
    • Security (CCTV, access control)
    • Wireless infrastructure
  • Ensure these systems are effectively integrated into overall network and ICT infrastructure design.

Data Center Design

  • Contribute to the design of data center infrastructure systems for enterprise, colocation, and mission-critical facilities.
  • Develop data hall layouts, rack plans, and cable management strategies.
  • Support design of MDA, HDA, and EDA environments, including backbone and horizontal distribution systems.
  • Incorporate considerations such as hot/cold aisle containment and scalability.
  • Assist in preparing construction documentation for fit-outs, upgrades, and new builds.
  • Coordinate ICT systems with electrical, mechanical, and other engineering disciplines.

Documentation & Software

  • Prepare all design drawings and deliverables using the Autodesk software suite, including Revit (MEP).
  • Develop BIM-coordinated ICT models for design coordination and clash detection workflows.
  • Produce specifications, design reports, bills of materials, and commissioning documentation.
  • Maintain accurate version control, project registers, and quality records throughout the project lifecycle.

Project Participation

  • Contribute to design review meetings, site visits, and client workshops under the direction of the project engineer.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, and project stakeholders to resolve design challenges.
  • Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and subcontractors during construction and commissioning phases.
  • Assist in responding to RFIs and reviewing shop drawings and contractor submittals.
  • Execute assigned design tasks independently within defined scope.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in ICT/structured cabling design, or network infrastructure design.
  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or related field.
  • RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) certification preferred — this is not a software/IT networking position.
  • Knowledge of network architecture and infrastructure design principles.
  • Experience with or exposure to data center environments.
  • Proficiency in Revit/AutoCAD, BICSI, TIA/EIA, construction drawings, rack elevations.
  • Proficiency Microsoft Office products, especially excel.
  • Working knowledge of structured cabling systems (fiber and copper), telecommunications spaces and pathways, and BICSI, TIA/EIA standards (including TIA-568).
  • Ability to work in a team environment with Project Managers, Engineers, and Designers.
  • Ability to produce clear, accurate, and coordinated design documentation.
  • Strong organizational and collaboration skills.
  • Communication skills both written and verbal are required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working on data center projects including hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise-scale facilities.
  • Familiarity with TIA-942 and BICSI TDMM, Uptime Institute Tier Standards or ANSI/BICSI 002 data center design guidelines.
  • Experience with BIM coordination workflows.
  • Exposure to active network equipment (switching, routing), DAS or in-building wireless systems, and/or DCIM platforms.

Compensation & Benefits:

The Senior Database Administrator is responsible for the design, implementation, optimization, and support of Experity’s cloud-native database platforms, focusing primarily on Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL running on AWS RDS.


This role plays a critical part in ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and security of mission-critical SaaS databases. The DBA partners closely with Engineering, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to operate a highly observable, resilient, and cost-efficient data platform.


This role is expected to act as a technical leader in database reliability and performance, influencing architecture decisions, mentoring team members, and driving operational excellence across multiple database platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Deploy, configure, and manage PostgreSQL and MySQL databases in AWS RDS and Aurora environments.
  • Configure and manage MySQL parameter groups, option groups, automated backups, snapshots, and maintenance windows.
  • Architect and support high availability solutions leveraging clusters, read replicas, Multi-AZ deployments, writer/reader endpoint strategies and read scaling.
  • Monitor and mitigate replication lag across replicas to ensure read consistency and performance.
  • Tune and manage database-specific parameters.
  • Optimize workloads for Aurora storage architecture, including I/O patterns, autovacuum behavior, and checkpoint tuning.
  • Optimize database indexing, query execution plans, and MySQL InnoDB configuration for production workloads
  • Monitor and troubleshoot database performance using AWS CloudWatch, DataDog, and Database-native tools (e.g., pg_stat_statements, EXPLAIN).
  • Analyze and optimize query performance, indexing strategies, and resource utilization.
  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, including locking, blocking, replication lag, and connection saturation.
  • Implement and manage backup and recovery strategies including point-in-time recovery (PITR), automated snapshots, and cross-region resilience.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve schema design, query patterns, and database access efficiency.
  • Drive observability best practices, including alerting, logging, and performance metrics across database environments.
  • Optimize cloud database cost and performance, including instance sizing, storage utilization, and workload tuning.
  • Support and contribute to database migrations and modernization efforts.
  • Automate database provisioning and operations using Infrastructure-as-Code and scripting.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement processes.
  • Support MySQL version upgrades, patching, and database migrations with minimal downtime.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of database administration experience, with 3+ years focused on PostgreSQL in high-volume OLTP production environments.
  • 2+ years administering MySQL in production, preferably on AWS RDS.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS RDS MySQL.
  • Deep understanding of PostgreSQL internals, including query planner, indexing, vacuuming, WAL, and replication.
  • Strong understanding of MySQL architecture, including InnoDB storage engine, replication, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Proven expertise in database performance tuning and troubleshooting in high-availability, high-throughput environments.
  • Experience supporting systems with significant transaction volume (e.g., 100–200+ TPS) and scaling for continued growth.
  • Experience troubleshooting contention scenarios, including locking, blocking, connection saturation, and long-running transactions.
  • Experience with AWS services including RDS, Aurora, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability platforms such as DataDog and CloudWatch.
  • Experience designing and supporting High Availability and Disaster Recovery solutions.
  • Strong understanding of relational database design and data modeling.
  • Experience with automation (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) and scripting (Python, Bash, etc.).
  • Experience operating in a production SaaS or high-transaction environment.

Team Member Competencies:

  • Demonstrates ownership and accountability for production systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering and operations teams.
  • Communicates clearly and effectively in both technical and non-technical contexts.
  • Continuously seeks to improve processes, performance, and reliability.

Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab.
jobs.description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

  • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
  • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
  • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
  • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

Learn more in our press release:

What You'll Do

    Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:
    Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.
    Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.
    Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.
    You will also:
  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

Who You Are

  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location
  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.
  • Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

jobs.title: Security Engineering Lead
jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Security Engineering Lead on our team, you'll be leading the security and auditing efforts for Espresso's codebase leading up to, and beyond, launch. We are looking for an experienced security engineering and software auditing professional who can lead review processes of our design and codebase. Experience in the domains of EVM smart contracts and/or Rust distributed systems is preferred for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead security audits of (a subset of) the Espresso codebase
  • As a project leader, you will have mobility in how you choose to organize security and audit efforts
  • Dive into the code of a fairly complex distributed system, learning and developing an understanding of the system on the fly (with help from the engineering team that built it, of course)
  • Coordinate with several engineering teams to aid in your audit, raise concerns and communicate results, and guide the effort to harden the system based on your findings
  • Coordinate with, manage, and review the work of external security auditing teams, in certain cases
  • Suggest improvements to testing and engineering practices to promote more secure and maintainable code

Requirements

  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, both low-level (e.g. language-specific best practices) and high-level (e.g. reliable software architecture, particularly in distributed systems)
  • If focused on Rust: ≥ 1 year experience writing Rust, particularly with async Rust.
  • If focused on Solidity: Multiple years experience writing smart contracts; experience with smart contract security audits or formal verification of smart contracts
  • Experience as an engineer or software architect in a security-critical industry
  • Be capable of describing the stakes, the challenges you've faced in building secure software, and the steps/processes you've taken to mitigate risk
  • Experience as an auditor, pentester, QA tester, etc.
  • Have a well thought-out approach to testing software and designing it to be testable/auditable
  • Ability to think adversarially, and identify potential reliability or security vulnerabilities even in software that is correct in common or “happy path” scenarios
  • Experience on the design and/or testing of distributed systems
  • Comfort diving into unknowns and asking questions

Preferred

  • Knowledge of relevant testing and static analysis tools (e.g. Foundry, Slither) is a plus
  • Blockchain knowledge/experience is preferred, but could also be include IoT, automotive, finance, etc.
  • Ideally, the candidate should have a general philosophy of software design that has been molded by experience working on security-critical systems

Benefits

  • Fully remote with flexible hours
  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package
  • Regular team off-sites to international locations
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees

We are standing up a dedicated QA automation function, and we're looking for a QA Engineering Manager to build and lead it from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to shape a quality practice from scratch: you'll choose the tooling, set the standards, hire the team, and define how AI fits into how we test.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll split your time roughly 50/50 between leading the team and doing the work yourself: setting direction, hiring, and coaching on one side, and writing automated tests, building framework components, and reviewing code on the other. You'll lead by example and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls and earn the trust of the engineers you lead.

In your first 90 days, you'll start with discovery: partnering with our Principal AI Engineer and AI team to understand existing AI tools and practices, and working with engineering teams to understand current QA practices and define how QA and engineering will collaborate going forward. In parallel, you'll confirm prerequisites (environments, CI/CD, critical user journeys), select your tooling and framework, and stand up a proof-of-concept suite on the highest-risk flows. By the end of year one, you'll have delivered a working, trusted automation suite on critical flows, a small high-performing team, a quality metrics dashboard in active use, and a clear plan for AI adoption.

What You Will Do

  • Define and own the quality engineering strategy and roadmap across our products.
  • Stay hands-on: personally write automated tests, build framework components, and review code alongside the team (roughly half your time).
  • Select the test automation tooling and framework, and set the standards squads build on.
  • Integrate automated testing into our CI/CD pipelines and partner with DevOps on stable, repeatable deployments.
  • Define quality gates: what blocks a merge and what blocks a release, aligned with engineering leadership and risk.
  • Drive a risk-based approach to testing so effort goes where it protects clients most.
  • Push tests down the stack (API before UI), drive down the flaky-test rate, and enable squads so the practice doesn't depend on any one person.
  • Hire, coach, and grow a team of automation engineers, and raise testing discipline across product squads.
  • Own quality metrics and a dashboard that leadership trusts, providing objective signals for go/no-go release decisions.
  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted testing tools (test generation, self-healing tests, defect triage, agentic testing) through a practical, hybrid model, while keeping a human-in-the-loop standard so AI-generated tests and code are reviewed, not trusted blindly.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in software quality or engineering, including 3+ years leading and growing engineers.
  • A track record of building or significantly maturing a test automation practice.
  • Current, hands-on coding ability: you can build framework components and write automated tests yourself, and you want to keep doing so in this role.
  • Strong technical judgement on automation frameworks, CI/CD, and test architecture, backed by recent hands-on experience.
  • Fluency with modern automation tooling (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experience defining quality metrics and using them to influence release decisions.
  • Clear communicator who can translate quality risk into terms leadership and product can act on.
  • Hands-on understanding of how AI is changing testing, with sound judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't. Experience evaluating or adopting AI-assisted QA tooling or a credible plan for doing so.
  • Familiarity with testing AI or LLM features (evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, bias and accuracy checks), or the ability to get there quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Claude and Claude Code.
  • Background as an SDET or automation engineer earlier in your career.
  • Experience introducing quality practices into an organisation that did not have them before.
  • Experience in a regulated or high-reliability domain (utilities, fintech, healthcare or similar).

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.

jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role Overview

Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Business Development Executive to join our global business.

Reporting directly to the General Manager of Southern Europe and working collaboratively with the Commercial team and strategic partners, you will be 100% focused on driving new business growth and expanding Fresha's presence across the region.

This is a remote role, offering the opportunity to take ownership of a high-growth territory while helping to accelerate Fresha's expansion. You will be responsible for identifying, prospecting, and engaging beauty and wellness businesses in your region, combining proactive field sales activity with a consultative approach to build strong local relationships and drive commercial success.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, enjoys working autonomously, embraces challenges, and wants to make a tangible impact on the growth of a leading global technology platform.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Spanish and another language - preferably Basque
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
    • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview process

  • Screening Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • 1st Stage - Video interview with Team Lead (45 mins)
  • Final Stage + Presentation - Video interview with Team Lead and General Manager (Europe) (75 mins)
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.excerpt: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.
jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

The Role

We’re looking for a driven and entrepreneurial Account Executive to join our growing commercial team.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting through to closing, helping beauty and wellness businesses unlock growth through Fresha’s platform.

This is a high-impact role suited to someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys building relationships from scratch, and is motivated by hitting and exceeding targets.

What You'll Do

  • Own a high-volume sales pipeline from prospecting through to close
  • Generate new business through outbound (calls, email, walk-ins) and inbound leads
  • Run efficient, tailored demos that clearly communicate value
  • Close deals quickly while maintaining a high-quality customer experience
  • Understand SMB pain points and position Fresha as a growth solution
  • Build trust with business owners and decision-makers
  • Consistently exceed monthly targets and activity metrics
  • Maintain clean pipeline management and accurate forecasting in CRM
  • Share market insights to help refine messaging and product direction
    • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What We're Looking For

    • 2+ years of experience in SMB sales, business development, or account executive roles
    • Proven ability to hit or exceed quota in a high-velocity environment
    • Strong prospecting and closing skills (you’re comfortable owning the full cycle)
    • A natural hunter who is also confident running consultative conversations
    • Excellent communication skills—especially with small business owners
    • Highly organized and able to manage multiple deals at once
    • Comfortable in a fast-paced, target-driven environment

      • Nice to have:

      • Experience in SaaS, marketplaces, or payments
      • Exposure to beauty, wellness, or local services industries

This Role Is a Great Fit if You

  • Enjoy high-activity, high-reward sales environments
  • Take ownership of your number and pipeline generation
  • Are motivated by closing consistently, not occasionally
  • Can balance speed with quality in customer conversations
  • You're competitive. You keep score and you want to win, but you also lift the people around you
  • You have a growth mindset. You want feedback, you act on it, and you get better every week
  • You're a self-starter. You don't need to be managed, you need to be supported and given room to perform
  • You're curious, ask great questions, and genuinely want to understand the businesses you're selling to
  • You're excited about being early.
    • Joining a rapidly scaling team means you'll have real influence on how we build and what we become.
    At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30m)
  • Skills & Experience - Virtual interview with one of our commercial leaders (45m)
  • Culture Fit - Video-call with the General Manager (30m)
  • Presentation - Interview with the Commercial leadership team (60m)
    • We aim to finalize the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
    Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Benefits

    • Work-life balance: 25 days of flexible leave that we encourage you to take.
    • Retirement: 401K with up to 3% match.
    • Insurance: Medical, up to 80% employer contribution.
    • Additional Perks: Wellness products/services Perkbox.
    • Dental, Vision, and life insurance.
    • Free Counseling.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

We are looking for a Senior SDET to help build our test automation from the ground up. By six months, you'll have meaningful automated coverage of critical user journeys, a low flaky-test rate, and faster feedback on every change.   • Drive down flakiness and keep the suite trustworthy, so failures mean something.
  • Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing tools (test generation, self-healing tests, failure triage), and use AI and prompt engineering to accelerate test creation and edge-case discovery.

What You Bring

  • Strong coding skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with a modern automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) including building or owning a framework, not just writing tests inside one.
  • Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) and comfort with SQL and database validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS) and containers (Docker).
  • A pragmatic, risk-based mindset and the judgement to know what's worth automating.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or AI test-generation tools in real work (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar), with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts to generate test ideas, edge cases, and to analyze failures.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Claude and Claude Code.
  • Experience setting up test automation from scratch on a team that had little automation before.
  • Performance testing (k6 / JMeter) or security testing exposure.

jobs.title: Instructional Designer
jobs.excerpt: Wij zijn hiervoor op zoek naar een instructional designer die ons kan helpen bij het ontwikkelen van kwalitatieve e-learning modules.
jobs.description:
Wij zijn hiervoor op zoek naar een instructional designer die ons kan helpen bij het ontwikkelen van kwalitatieve e-learning modules. Als instructional designer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het omzetten van bestaande kennis naar educatieve en boeiende e-learning modules die de inhoud duidelijk en effectief overbrengen aan ons publiek.

Functieomschrijving:

  • Ontwikkelen van e-learning modules in overeenstemming met de doelstellingen van het project en de vereisten van de klant.

  • Samenwerken met het productieteam om de inhoud van de video's te begrijpen en te vertalen naar een e-learning concept.

  • Onderzoeken van de doelgroep om de inhoud van de modules op een aantrekkelijke manier te presenteren.

  • Werken aan meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd en de deadlines bijhouden.

  • Aanpassen en bewerken van de modules na feedback van de klant en het productieteam.

Functie-eisen:

  • Ervaring met het bouwen van e-learning in moderne web-based tools zoals Easygenerator of Articulate Rise.

  • Ervaring met het editen van video’s in Premiere Pro of een vergelijkbare applicatie.

  • In staat om goede, pakkende en heldere teksten te schrijven.

  • Vloeiend in zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal, gepsroken en geschreven.

  • Oog voor kwaliteit: de behoefte om pixel-perfect op te leveren.

  • Teamspeler en in staat om effectief te communiceren en te werken met anderen.

  • Creatief en in staat om nieuwe ideeën en concepten te bedenken.

  • Goede organisatorische vaardigheden en in staat om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren.

Loopbaan:

Je begint bij ons meteen met leren. De eerste dagen ga je trainingen volgen die wij voor onze klanten hebben gemaakt. Het zijn interessante trainingen met bedrijfskundige onderwerpen, waar je veel van kunt opsteken.

Dan gaan we je laten zien hoe wij scripts schrijven, video’s editen en cursussen inrichten. Onder begeleiding van jouw mentor - een ervaren e-learning expert - ga je al snel aan de slag om waardevolle producten te maken voor onze klanten. Je blijft je hele loopbaan dagelijks leren: Of het nu gaat om e-learning of om de producten van onze klanten waar de trainingen over gaan.

Van jou wordt verwacht dat je meewerkt aan het verbeteren van de content die wij aanbieden en aan het promoten van onze diensten aan potentiële nieuwe klanten. Wij verwachten dat je tijdens jouw loopbaan vakliteratuur leest en cursussen volgt om jouw kennis up to date te houden.

Verloop van de sollicitatieprocedure

Wij publiceren meerdere vacatures, en op elke vacature kun je je inschrijven. We verwachten van jou een CV en een portfolio. Je mag een korte toelichting toevoegen, maar wel zelf geschreven. Tip: Omdat het een creatieve functie betreft, kijken we zowel naar de inhoud als naar het design van jouw CV. Heb je ervaring in het maken van video’s en/of animaties? Stuur dan in jouw brief ook wat links mee naar het werk dat je hebt gemaakt.

De deadline voor het insturen van jouw sollicitatie is 1 juni 2025. Na deze datum zullen wij de profielen gaan bekijken en kiezen wij 5 kandidaten uit voor een gesprek.

Ben jij creatief, leg je graag dingen aan anderen uit en wil je vanuit huis werken? Maxcademy is een internationaal e-learning bedrijf met roots in Nederland. We hebben een geweldige kans voor een professional om ons team te versterken!

Maxcademy B.V. is een ervaren, maar dynamisch en jong e-learning bureau. We richten ons op het maken van moderne educatieve producten zoals e-learning, minigames en animatievideo’s.

Onze klanten zijn heel divers: van multinationals tot gemeentes. Daarom komen er bij ons ook veel interessante onderwerpen voorbij in de trainingen die wij schrijven. Dit zijn wat voorbeelden van cursussen die we onlangs hebben geschreven voor onze klanten:

  • Hoe kun je jouw bedrijf circulair maken?

  • Hoe wekt een boer groene energie op?

  • Wat is een ERP systeem, hoe implementeer je deze bij een groot productiebedrijf?

  • Hoe richt je je bedrijfsprocessen efficiënt in?

  • Welke enzymen komen in melk voor, en welke functies hebben deze in het menselijk lichaam?

Zoals je ziet zijn onze onderwerpen dus heel divers. Daarom zijn er bij onze projecten altijd experts betrokken. Deze experts helpen onze instructional designers met het vinden van de inhoud. Jij moet hen helpen om dit op te schrijven en samen met de rest van het team te visualiseren. Het is belangrijk dat je je inleest op het onderwerp en het minstens even goed begrijpt als de cursist die de training gaat volgen.

jobs.description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!

WHO WE ARE

Outdoor Afro celebrates and inspires Black connections and leadership in nature. Our network also connects Black people with our lands, water, and wildlife through outdoor education, recreation, and conservation. Examples of Outdoor Afro’s year-round activities range from fishing, hiking, biking, kayaking, gardening, skiing and more! Visit: to learn more.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Strategic Development & Partnerships Director oversees the strategy and operational excellence of Outdoor Afro’s partnerships and development efforts. In addition to driving revenue generation and partnership opportunities, the role emphasizes building strong departmental processes, managing donor relations technology, streamlining grant administration, and ensuring alignment between development operations and organizational goals development goals of the organization.

Who You Are

  • You're a seasoned mentor, having guided your teams to excellence and ensuring they reach their full potential.
  • Entrepreneurial at heart, you're adept at shaping policies and strategies from the ground up while thriving in dynamic environments.
  • A strategic partnership aficionado, you blend process efficiency with genuine relationship-building, understanding the twin pillars of successful fundraising.
  • Your personal outdoor experiences align with our mission, emphasizing the importance of Black connections with nature and advocating for equitable access.
  • Data-driven, you see the overarching picture, and value analytics just as much as interpersonal connections in driving development success.
  • An operations enthusiast, you're always seeking ways to refine processes and heighten efficiency.
  • Trust is your watchword, and you cherish every relationship – from major donors to volunteers, understanding the intricate value of each.
  • Passionate about technology, you harness donor management tools to streamline operations and extract meaningful insights.
  • An empathetic leader, you motivate with understanding and collaboration, fostering an environment where every voice matters.
  • Adaptable and proactive, you revel in change, always ready to evolve for the organization's betterment.
  • Ever-curious, you're consistently exploring new trends, tools, and strategies in nonprofit operations and fundraising.

Fundraising and External Relationship Development

  • Collaborate closely with the CEO and Executive Director to shape and continuously refine long-term fundraising strategies, ensuring they align with the organization's overarching goals and set the groundwork for sustained funding sources.
  • Dive deep into the nuances of the fundraising process, leveraging data analytics and internal feedback to identify areas for improvement, and ensuring continuous enhancement of departmental operations.
  • Progressively take on a pivotal role in donor relationship management, eventually becoming the primary lead, allowing the organization's Founder to focus on high-level strategic endeavors and broad organizational vision.
  • Foster and nurture existing funder relationships, using advanced donor management tools to ensure consistent, impactful interactions and expanded recurring revenue streams.
  • Draw from data insights within donor relation platforms to discern vital trends, uncover fresh opportunities, and effectively guide and support donor engagements.
  • Oversee grant compliance and reporting, while coordinating with internal team members to ensure that grant utilization aligns seamlessly with available operational resources and organizational goals.
  • Lead the planning and execution of fundraising events, ensuring that event logistics harmoniously integrate with development objectives, while also ensuring that fundraising initiatives benefit from the most effective operational strategies and tools available.

Development Operations

  • Strengthen and optimize the business development department operations, processes, procedures, and infrastructure.
  • Oversee the implementation and management of donor relations software (e.g., Salesforce) to enhance donor engagement and improve data insights.
  • Evaluate and recommend technologies, tools, and platforms that can streamline development and fundraising operations.
  • Develop or refine development policies and procedures to ensure best practices. Create and continually refine fundraising SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the development department.
  • Collaborate with the CEO and senior management on financial planning, budgeting, cash flow, and other operational matters.
  • Coordinate closely with other departments to ensure seamless alignment of strategies and initiatives.

Cross Functional Collaboration & Partnership Management

  • Partner with the program team to integrate fundraising initiatives with organizational programs and events - serving as the primary partner owner for the organization.
  • Manage regular reporting on partner needs, and deliverables; elevate issues to the Executive Team.
  • Serve as the primary Outdoor Afro representative and point of contact for partners, donors and the internal team driving all communications and follow-up items - sharing widely with the team as necessary.
  • Work with other departments to ensure that fundraising strategies are synchronized with organizational capabilities, resources, and timelines.
  • Oversee the day to day operational management of the Outdoor Afro’s partner relationships, ensuring donor and partner retention annually.
  • Develop strong relationships with corporate partner representatives.
  • Apply a customer centric approach to strategically approach partnership goals, ensuring alignment with Outdoor Afro’s mission.
  • Serve as an internal partner representative for the larger Outdoor Afro team to identify partner needs, deliverables and regular communications
  • Escalate potential conflicts of interest or issues to the Outdoor Afro Executive Team in a timely fashion as needed.

Leadership & Strategy

  • Participate in, and plan strategy meetings with the CEO and executive management team regarding exigent communications, partnerships, and large events.
  • Supervise fund development staff and consultants; develop individual goals, provide ongoing feedback, one-on-one meetings and conduct performance assessments
  • Actively participate in and provide leadership for strategic plan implementation in collaboration with the CEO and key staff. Coach staff as they implement strategic initiatives pertaining to fund development and partnership strategies.
  • Maintain continuous lines of communication within the Outdoor Afro HQ staff; identify and implement solutions to key issues; keep the CEO informed of critical issues and identify solutions.
  • Provide organizational leadership, insight, and expertise to the CEO and senior management on financial planning, budgeting, cash flow and other policy matters.
  • Provide leadership to the Board of Directors and relevant committees to communicate critical fund development matters. Write reports, including quarterly reports to the Board of Directors and its various operating committees.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field such as Nonprofit Management, Business Administration, Marketing, Public Relations, or another relevant area.
  • Master's Degree (Preferred but not mandatory): Advanced degrees like an MBA, Master's in Nonprofit Management, or a related discipline a plus.
  • 8-10 years in fund and/or business development roles, w/ significant portion of time spent in leadership or managerial positions. Candidates with corporate sales, account management and corporate partnership development are encouraged to apply.
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing development department operations, including refining processes, implementing new technologies, and managing donor relations software.
  • Proven track record of successful fundraising, including cultivating and maintaining relationships, securing major gifts, planning fundraising events, and grant writing.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects and tracking key performance indicators; experience using project management software such as Asana.
  • Advanced skills in the G-Suite and/or MS Office. Experience managing donor relations software (CRM), Salesforce, or similar software is required.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Strategic Vision: Guides, inspires, & develops teams to align with departmental and organizational objectives. Envisions short and long-term fundraising goals in harmony with organization's mission.
  • Operational & Data Mastery: Understands how to streamline business processes for efficiency and effectiveness while harnessing insights from donor relations software to inform strategies.
  • Partnership & Relationship Building: Excels in building & maintaining strong ties with diverse stakeholders, from corporate partners to community organizations. Understands nonprofit and corporate dynamics, and bridges communication gaps effectively.
  • Technical Proficiency & Grant Management: Familiar with tools like Salesforce and the intricacies of grant sourcing, application, compliance, and reporting.
  • Budget Oversight & Project Management: Plans & manages budgets for organizational growth and adeptly oversees multiple projects for timely completion.
  • Communication & Collaborative Mindset: Clearly articulates ideas & strategies to all stakeholders and works closely with other departments, aligning fundraising with broader strategies.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: Identifies challenges & devises solutions in evolving environments, and pivots strategies responsively to changes.
  • Ethical Standards & Continuous Learning: Upholds professionalism, ethics, & confidentiality while staying updated on best practices in philanthropy and nonprofit management.

Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!

THE COMPANY
Blended Technologies is bringing modern SaaS to the wine industry. Our products will give winemakers the tools to manage all aspects of the winemaking process from grape to bottle, and will allow winery owners to optimize their business with tailored workflows, inventory tracking, tasting room management, direct-to-consumer sales, and CRM. We help owners and winemakers spend less time on tax and compliance paperwork and more time making great wine and keeping customers happy.
We are a fully-funded seed-stage startup rounding out our initial engineering team that is conceiving, designing, building, and bringing our product to market. We are offering competitive salary and benefits as well as single-digit-employee-number equity.
THE ROLE
Being one of the first engineering hires at a startup is a special thing – you’ll never have a greater impact, you’ll never have more opportunity, you’ll never get a bigger piece of the pie, and you’ll never have more fun. This position reports directly to an experienced CTO with decades of experience at Google, Netflix, Apple, Twilio and other tech-focused companies.
We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer to help design and build our service from the ground up. You should have built big things before, have opinions about what works and what doesn’t, and can work independently on even bigger things. There isn’t always going to be a clear map that explains how to get where we want to go, so you should be comfortable trying to understand our customer needs really well, be given some UI sketches, a data schema, and coworkers to collaborate with, and be excited to figure out the rest from there.

What We're Looking For:

The Role

As Vice President of Marketing, you will own Health Evolution's brand voice and marketing engine, including building the strategy, campaigns, and infrastructure that make our Summits, Exchanges, Hubs, Networks, and Forum unmissable to the most influential leaders in health care.

Reporting to the Executive Vice President of Marketing & Operations, this is a high-visibility role that blends data-driven strategy, brand, media, and communications leadership, and hands-on campaign execution. You will partner closely with the Executive Chairman, Commercial, Product/Experience, and Partnerships teams to ensure marketing amplifies every stage of the member journey, and you will bring AI-enabled ways of working into how the team plans, creates, and measures its impact.

Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Data

  • Develop and own Health Evolution's integrated marketing strategy, from brand, demand generation, to member engagement, all aligned to organizational growth and retention goals
  • Build a measurement and analytics framework that connects marketing activity to pipeline, membership growth, event utilization, and renewal
  • Use data to continuously refine strategy and prove ROI to executive leadership
  • Set the marketing roadmap and prioritize initiatives against clear KPIs

Brand, PR, Media & Communications

  • Lead the positioning, messaging, and go-to-market planning for Health Evolution's brand and major convenings
  • Direct PR strategy and execution, including launch campaigns that elevate Health Evolution's voice in health care media and industry conversations
  • Curate brand narrative and creative standards that hold up to a C-suite audience
  • Serve as a key media contact, building relationships with health care trade and business press to secure coverage and manage inbound press inquiries
  • Oversee internal and external communications, including executive and member communications, ensuring consistent messaging across all channels

Social & Digital Marketing

  • Architect always-on and campaign-specific social media strategy and frameworks across channels, tailored to an executive and highly credentialed audience
  • Oversee content, paid, and organic programs that build reach without diluting brand credibility

AI-Enabled Marketing

  • Champion the practical use of AI across the marketing function — content development, personalization, campaign optimization, and workflow efficiency
  • Scale output and sharpen targeting without sacrificing quality or voice

Team & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing marketing and communications team
  • Partner closely with Product/Experience, Commercial, and Operations teams to ensure marketing amplifies the member journey, from awareness and recruitment through onboarding, engagement, and renewal
  • Own the marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, and prioritization across competing initiatives

Qualifications & Attributes

  • Marketing Leadership: 10–15 years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership of a marketing function or major marketing pillar within a growth-oriented or brand-sensitive organization.
  • Strategic & Data-Driven Marketing: Demonstrated ability to build and execute a marketing strategy grounded in data — from audience segmentation and funnel analysis to measurement of campaign and channel performance.
  • Brand, PR, Media & Communications Leadership: Track record of developing and launching PR, media relations, and branding campaigns, including managing agency and media relationships, serving as a spokesperson, and shaping narrative and communications for a discerning, senior audience.
  • Social Media Expertise: Hands-on experience designing social media campaigns and frameworks, with fluency across platforms and formats appropriate to an executive audience.
  • AI Fluency: Practical, applied experience using AI tools and platforms to inform marketing strategy, content creation, personalization, or operational efficiency.
  • Industry Knowledge: Marketing experience within health care, professional membership organizations, associations, or premium B2B communities serving a C-suite or executive audience is strongly preferred.
  • Executive Presence: Credible, polished communicator able to represent the brand directly to CEOs, health system leaders, and board-level audiences.
  • Leadership: Experience building and leading marketing teams, managing budgets, and operating as a trusted partner to executive leadership; comfortable in a fast-moving, still-scaling environment.

Benefits

  • Ability to work remotely
  • Competitive compensation
  • Competitive, comprehensive health care coverage
  • Flexible paid time off
  • 401k w/company match

Health Evolution is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Health Evolution is a selective membership of chief executives and influential leaders from the most impactful organizations across the health care industry.

Our members embrace bold ideas, drive meaningful innovation, lead with courage, and collaborate to advance a health care system that is more accessible and affordable, more effective and equitable, and more proactive and personalized.

Project Overview

Help shape the future of AI in Brazil!

We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market.

We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Internet Culture (memes, social challenges, and street interviews-related)to create high‑quality, expert‑level question‑and‑answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese.

Suitable backgrounds may include digital culture research, social media strategy, meme analysis, online community management, content creation, internet journalism, or cultural commentary focused on Brazilian online spaces. Relevant profiles could include influencers, digital marketers, trend analysts, professional content creators, podcast hosts, street interview creators, or individuals with recognized experience studying or shaping internet culture, viral trends, social challenges, and online communities in Brazil.

Please submit your resume/CV in English.

Project Details

  • Job Type: Freelance
  • Location: Brazil (Remote) - Open to candidates in Curitiba, Porto Alegre, Florianópolis, Belo Horizonte, Campinas, Vitória, Goiânia, Recife, Fortaleza, Natal, João Pessoa, Maceió, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Brasília, including but not limited to
  • Work Schedule: Part-time (10+ hours per week), fully flexible
  • Rate: 21,60 USD/hour
  • Start Date: Mid-June
  • Duration: Approx. 2 months
    • We offer paid training upon hiring.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop advanced, open-ended questions grounded in realistic, real-world scenarios related to internet culture, digital communities, memes, viral phenomena, social media behavior, and online trends within the Brazilian market
  • Provide in-depth, accurate, and well-structured answers supported by strong domain knowledge
  • Incorporate Brazil-specific cultural, social, and regulatory context where relevant
  • Design content that requires critical thinking, nuance, and multi-step reasoning
  • Ensure clarity, precision, and consistently high writing quality in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Follow detailed project guidelines and meet agreed timelines and quality standards
    • Use of AI tools to generate answers or questions is strictly prohibited.

Requirements

  • Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field
  • Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner
  • Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality output in a guideline-driven environment

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation
  • Familiarity with AI training, data annotation, or evaluation projects
  • Background in interdisciplinary work (e.g. media studies, sociology, digital anthropology, online communities, platform culture)

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to registered businesses in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. jobs.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (there may be some in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Portuguese & English.
  • Any other another language is a bonus!
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - Video/In-person interview with Head of Sales (Europe) (45 mins)
  • Presentation - Online Case Study for 60 minutes with Team Lead of Business Development & General Manager of Spain.
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
  • Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, eager to solve complex technical problems, and excited to work collaboratively across teams to support scalable and reliable business operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the setup, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of server, storage, and GPU-based infrastructure environments
  • Support cloud infrastructure and services across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools using languages such as Python, Shell scripting, Java, or JavaScript
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and operational health to ensure reliability and efficiency
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support infrastructure modernization and operational improvements
  • Participate in troubleshooting hardware, software, networking, and cloud-related issues
  • Assist with infrastructure documentation, reporting, and process improvement initiatives
  • Utilize data visualization and reporting tools such as Excel, Power BI, or Tableau to analyze operational metrics and support decision-making
  • Explore and support the integration of Generative AI tools and concepts into infrastructure management and operational workflows
  • Contribute to a collaborative team environment while demonstrating initiative, adaptability, and problem-solving capabilities
  • Support incident response procedures and escalation protocols to minimize system downtime and operational disruptions
  • Assist with security and compliance monitoring activities to ensure infrastructure environments meet organizational and regulatory standards
  • Participate in capacity planning and resource optimization initiatives to support scalable infrastructure growth
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of technical knowledge bases and runbooks to support team efficiency and knowledge sharing
  • Support backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures to protect critical infrastructure and data assets
  • Assist with network configuration, monitoring, and optimization activities to ensure reliable connectivity and performance across enterprise systems

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field
  • Graduation date between May 2025 and August 2026
  • Less than 6 months of relevant full-time work experience
  • Basic understanding of computer systems, networking, and cloud computing concepts
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team-oriented environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, HTML, Perl, or Shell scripting

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities

  • And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our WellnessLine, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

jobs.excerpt: 【岗位职责】一、交易聚合与路由1. 负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。 2.
jobs.description:
【岗位职责】

一、交易聚合与路由

1.负责 Web3 聚合交易系统的后端架构设计与开发，整合多条公链、多个 DEX 及做市商流动性来源。

2.设计并实现路由算法与最优路径选择策略，平衡价格、滑点、Gas、成交概率等多目标。

3.负责交易构造、签名、广播、状态追踪的完整链路，保障高并发与网络拥堵场景下的稳定性与成功率。

二、询价与做市商接入

1.设计并实现询价（RFQ / Quote）系统，接入链上池子、链下做市商、CEX 等多类报价源。

2.负责做市商接入协议的设计与实现，覆盖报价订阅、更新、成交确认与风控校验。

3.构建报价质量评估与做市商分级机制，动态调整路由权重。

三、高并发与低延迟

1.优化询价、路由、交易链路的端到端延迟与吞吐能力。

2.设计交易风控与限流机制，覆盖滑点保护、价格偏离、重放保护、Gas 异常等场景。

【任职要求】

一、技术基础

1.5 年以上后端开发经验，3 年以上 Golang 实战经验，精通并发模型（Goroutine / Channel）、标准库及主流框架（Gin / Go-zero / Gorm）。

2.熟练掌握微服务架构与分布式系统设计（消息队列、分布式锁、熔断限流、幂等设计等）。

3.精通 SQL / NoSQL 数据库优化，熟悉 Redis 缓存设计及 Kafka 异步处理。

具备低延迟、高并发系统的设计与优化经验。

4.至少 3 年 Web3 开发经验，理解区块链基本原理，熟悉交易流程与合约交互机制。

5.熟悉主流公链交互机制，要求熟悉 EVM 与 Solana；熟悉 Sui / Ton 者优先。

熟悉交易构造、签名、广播、Nonce 管理、Gas 策略等链上交易全链路，具备主网交易系统的实战经验。

6.熟悉主流 DEX（Uniswap V2 / V3、Curve、Raydium、Orca 等）的池子模型、价格计算与状态维护。

7.具备聚合器（如 1inch、Jupiter、OKX 等）的实际开发经验，主导或深度参与过路由算法、报价聚合或交易执行链路的设计与落地。

8.主导过中大型后端系统从 0 到 1 的架构设计与落地。

9.具备较强的学习能力，能快速跟进新技术、新公链、新协议，并判断其在业务中的实际价值与落地路径。

二、AI 工程能力

1.日常使用 AI Coding Agent 开发，并有相应工程沉淀。

2.具备搭建 Agent Harness、编写 Skills / Prompts 的实践经验。

3.了解 MCP、Tool Use、RAG、Eval 等概念及其工程落地边界。

【加分项】

1.有做市商系统、报价引擎、订单管理（OMS）相关的开发经验。

2.有 MEV、Mempool 监听、Bundle 提交（如 Flashbots、Jito）等相关经验。

3.有跨链桥、跨链交易、Intent-based 交易（CoW、UniswapX、Across 等）相关的开发经验。

4.有围绕 AI Coding 的内部工具、Skill 库、Agent 工作流等沉淀经验。

5.有开源社区贡献或技术博客输出。
